insights.takeaway: Turn your cooking expertise into a business by preparing and delivering meals to local corporate offices or by specializing in bakery items like cakes and pastries for events.
insights.quote: If we feel, That we can serve food for 5 to 10 people in 1, 2 hours then you can tie up with a corporate, office or mall

insights.takeaway: Stadiums often prohibit outside water bottles, forcing attendees to buy overpriced beverages inside. Always check the stadium's prohibited items list before attending to avoid having your belongings confiscated.
insights.quote: Before entering the premises of the ground, your water bottle is taken.

insights.takeaway: Selling products above the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is generally illegal in India. If you are overcharged for water or food, you can file a complaint in the Consumer Court.
insights.quote: It is against the law to sell a product for more than the MRP.

insights.takeaway: Many stadiums prohibit carrying coins, citing safety concerns. Be aware that these confiscated coins are often collected by security, and there is little transparency regarding where this money goes.
insights.quote: No coins are allowed inside the stadium.

insights.takeaway: Do not buy merchandise like flags or caps outside the stadium, as security often prohibits them from being taken inside. Often, similar items are provided for free within the venue.
insights.quote: Please do not purchase them. We purchased some merchandise outside the stadium but the security did not let us take it inside.

insights.takeaway: When booking tickets for outdoor events, check the stadium orientation. Choosing a seat in the West stand for afternoon matches can save you from sitting in direct, harsh sunlight.
insights.quote: If you’re going to watch the match between 4 PM to 8 PM, make sure your seats are in the West stand.

insights.takeaway: If you face unfair practices like price gouging or poor facilities, use digital platforms to tag official accounts or file a formal complaint with the Consumer Court to demand accountability.
insights.quote: You can also oppose this in the Consumer Court. In Consumer Court, you can show your opposition by filing complaints.

insights.takeaway: If your employer fails to verify your KYC, it is often because their Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) is not registered or updated on the PF portal.
insights.quote: Most of the employers do not verify the KYC, because their digital signature is not registered.

insights.takeaway: Employers must register their DSC to perform essential tasks like verifying challans and accessing government benefits like PMRPY.
insights.quote: If your digital signature is not registered, then you cannot even verify the challan.

insights.takeaway: If your company has closed down, submit your KYC documents along with an application containing your UAN and PF number directly to your local PF office.
insights.quote: Send your documents to the PF Department, along with an application to the local PF department where you are already registered.

insights.takeaway: The EPF Grievance Management System (EPFIGMS) is a last resort for unresolved KYC issues when an employer refuses to cooperate.
insights.quote: Treat this Grievance portal as a means of last resort, as there is no surity that you will get the results.

insights.takeaway: When filing an EPF grievance for KYC, select 'Others' as the category and clearly explain that your employer is failing to approve your KYC details.
insights.quote: In this, there is no specific KYC category, so click on Others.

insights.takeaway: Always try to resolve KYC issues through direct communication with your employer first, as formal complaints can create unnecessary friction.
insights.quote: Why should we fight? When the work can be done with patience, why should we fight?

insights.takeaway: Always download and save your PF passbooks from all previous employers before initiating a transfer to ensure you can verify the total balance later.
insights.quote: The best practice is that you download both or all your passbooks.

insights.takeaway: Ensure your date of exit is correctly marked by your previous employer in the EPFO portal, as the transfer process cannot proceed without this status.
insights.quote: One thing you have to keep in mind the exit date should be marked otherwise the transfer will be difficult.

insights.takeaway: Pension funds do not show up as a cash balance in your PF passbook. They are accounted for in your service history records upon successful transfer.
insights.quote: Whenever you transfer the pension money it will not be reflected in your passbook it will get updated in the service history.

insights.takeaway: When requesting a PF transfer, you can choose to have the request approved by either your current or previous employer, depending on who is more accessible.
insights.quote: You have to choose an employer from whom you want to approve the transfer.

insights.takeaway: After submitting your online transfer request, you must track the status to ensure your employer digitally approves the claim to finalize the merger.
insights.quote: Your employer has to approve your claim through your digital signature.

insights.takeaway: The standard timeline for merging multiple PF accounts into a single active account after employer approval is approximately 10 to 15 days.
insights.quote: Both your PF accounts will merge in 10-15 days.

insights.takeaway: Intraday trading involves buying and selling stocks within the same day. It requires a trading account, not a Demat account, and focuses on short-term price fluctuations rather than long-term value.
insights.quote: This is not investing at all we call this INTRADAY TRADING.

insights.takeaway: Leverage, or margin, allows traders to buy more shares than their capital permits by borrowing from the broker. While it magnifies potential profits, it also significantly increases the risk of total capital loss.
insights.quote: This 9000 rupees which the broker gave me through which, I am buying shares This is called leverage or margin.

insights.takeaway: A stop-loss order is a risk management tool that automatically sells your shares if the price hits a predetermined level, helping to limit potential losses during volatile market movements.
insights.quote: What is Stoploss? At the time of buying shares or after buying even You can place a Stoploss order

insights.takeaway: Brokers earn revenue primarily through brokerage fees charged on every transaction. Because intraday traders execute frequent trades, they generate significant commission income for brokers regardless of the trader's profit or loss.
insights.quote: The majority source of revenue of the broker comes from intraday traders only.

insights.takeaway: Intraday trading is a high-risk, full-time profession that requires deep expertise. Avoid anyone promising guaranteed daily returns, as even experienced traders frequently face significant losses.
insights.quote: Whenever someone calls you that you can earn 5000 or 6000 per day then reject him with folded hands

insights.takeaway: Long-term investing leverages the power of compounding. Consistent monthly SIPs in strong, market-leading companies are a more reliable way to build significant wealth over decades compared to speculative trading.
insights.quote: You will make more than 4.5 crores of money this is the power of compounding

insights.takeaway: You can file a consumer complaint online through the official e-daakhil portal if you are overcharged or cheated by a seller or service provider.
insights.quote: वेबसाइट पे और यहां पर ऊपर कंज्यूमर एडवोकेट सेक्शन में आपको लॉग इन करना है

insights.takeaway: When filing a consumer case, the claim amount you enter determines the mandatory filing fee you must pay to proceed with the complaint.
insights.quote: आप जितना क्लेम अमाउंट भरोगे उसी के हिसाब से आपको एंड में एक छोटी सी फीस भी पे करनी पड़ेगी

insights.takeaway: Fields marked with an asterisk on the consumer complaint form are mandatory and must be filled accurately to avoid rejection of your application.
insights.quote: छोटे-छोटे स्टार्स दिख रहे हैं वो ये बताते हैं कि ये ऑप्शनल नहीं मैंडेटरी फील्ड है

insights.takeaway: You can represent yourself in consumer court without hiring an advocate by leaving the advocate details section blank during the filing process.
insights.quote: अगर आपके पास कोई एडवोकेट नहीं है तो इस फील्ड को जैसे का तैसा छोड़ दें

insights.takeaway: To file a valid complaint, you must upload an index, a list of dates and events, a memo of parties, and a formal complaint with an affidavit on stamp paper.
insights.quote: आपके पास एक स्टैंप पेपर पे एफिडेविट होना चाहिए जिसमें आपके केस से जुड़ी सारी डिटेल्स हैं

insights.takeaway: After filing your complaint, the redressal process begins within 48 hours. You must regularly check the portal for updates and virtual hearing dates.
insights.quote: 48 घंटे के अंदर उसका रिड्रेसल का प्रोसेस चालू हो जाएगा आपको रेगुलरली वेबसाइट पे विजिट करना पड़ेगा

insights.takeaway: Stop sending generic cold emails. Clients reject them because they lack research. Instead, study the client's work, provide genuine feedback, and show how you can specifically add value to their business.
insights.quote: Freelancers don't know their clients at all.

insights.takeaway: Treat your freelance career like a business, not a side hustle. You must master sales, marketing, and professional communication alongside your core technical skills to succeed.
insights.quote: It is as challenging as growing a small business, if not more.

insights.takeaway: Don't just be a craftsman who follows templates. Be an architect who ideates, researches the target audience, and strategizes every project to align with the client's specific goals and mood.
insights.quote: You shouldn't open Photoshop or Canva immediately. You should first ideate the topic in your head.

insights.takeaway: Build a personal brand by becoming a creator. Teaching what you know on platforms like YouTube or Instagram proves your expertise and attracts clients to you, reducing reliance on freelance marketplaces.
insights.quote: One of the easiest ways to become a creator is to start teaching what you already know.

insights.takeaway: When starting out, prioritize networking and learning over immediate payment. Working for free on high-quality projects can earn you valuable shoutouts, testimonials, and industry connections that lead to paid work.
insights.quote: Collaborations and networking are more important than money.

insights.takeaway: Persistence is key. If a client rejects you, follow up professionally after a reasonable time. Consistent, respectful follow-ups demonstrate professionalism and keep you on the client's radar.
insights.quote: He refused at first but I followed-up after 10 days, so he said okay, let's do it.

insights.takeaway: Avoid overwhelming yourself by focusing on the next immediate step rather than the entire journey. Break your skill development and business growth into small, daily, actionable tasks.
insights.quote: Today, in this moment we just have to move one step ahead and we will understand what the next step will be.

insights.takeaway: Never pay money for mobile tower installation. Legitimate telecom companies and infrastructure providers never charge processing fees, security deposits, or NOC charges to landowners.
insights.quote: If anyone's asking you for money in advance, then become extra cautious.

insights.takeaway: Telecom companies identify locations based on network demand, not by accepting applications from the public. They typically approach landowners directly if a site is needed.
insights.quote: The company identifies such a place and after that, the tower is installed there.

insights.takeaway: Verify any mobile tower installation offer by checking the official Department of Telecommunications (DOT) website for a list of authorized infrastructure providers.
insights.quote: Only these people in this country are permitted to install Telecommunication towers. Their list is also given on the DOT website.

insights.takeaway: Be skeptical of high rental promises. Mobile tower rents are typically modest, ranging from Rs 5,000 in rural areas to Rs 50,000 in dense metro cities; offers of lakhs are scams.
insights.quote: These 1L, 1.5L that they talk about are all fake.

insights.takeaway: Fraudsters often use Google Ads to appear at the top of search results. Do not trust a website just because it appears as an advertisement on Google.
insights.quote: If you search on Google, then you will find several ads. This ad symbol ahead. This is the Ad.

insights.takeaway: If you suspect a mobile tower scam, report it to your local police station or the local Department of Telecommunications (TERM) office.
insights.quote: You can complain in your local police station. And If you are not able to do that, then, Local Tele Communication Office Term.

insights.takeaway: Be wary of 'work from home' data entry jobs that demand advance payments for software, registration, or outsourcing fees. Legitimate employers pay you, not the other way around.
insights.quote: If you are already caught in this scam but you have not paid a single rupee then you can ignore these people.

insights.takeaway: Scammers often create multiple websites with identical content, layouts, and 'About Us' pages, changing only the logo and name to trap more victims simultaneously.
insights.quote: All three websites have the same Home page. All three websites have the same About Us page.

insights.takeaway: Check website credibility by testing interactive elements. If social media icons like Instagram or Facebook simply reload the current page instead of redirecting, the site is likely fraudulent.
insights.quote: As soon as I clicked on Instagram, the same page gets reloaded and not redirected to Instagram.

insights.takeaway: High search engine rankings or Alexa rankings do not guarantee legitimacy. Scammers use SEO keywords like 'Part-time job' and 'Work from Home' to manipulate traffic and appear credible.
insights.quote: Because of this trend of Work from Home, Part time jobs are increasing.

insights.takeaway: If a third party contacts you claiming they can complete your pending work for a fee, it is a classic scam. They aim to steal your advance payment and your account credentials.
insights.quote: We will complete that work on a 50% sharing.

insights.takeaway: Never share your login credentials for any work portal with third parties. Doing so gives scammers access to your account, personal data, and potential payment information.
insights.quote: Just share your user id and password with us.

insights.takeaway: Stock market profits are not just the difference between buy and sell prices. You must account for brokerage, exchange fees, GST, STT, SEBI charges, and stamp duty.
insights.quote: you will never get the total Rs 5000 back to your bank account.

insights.takeaway: Full-service brokers often charge high account opening fees and annual maintenance costs (AMC), whereas discount brokers are generally cheaper for both opening and maintenance.
insights.quote: account opening charge is very high, if you open your demat account with a full service broker.

insights.takeaway: Intraday trading involves brokerage fees per order, often capped at a maximum amount (e.g., Rs 20) with discount brokers, while full-service brokers may charge a percentage without a cap.
insights.quote: if you buy shares in large quantities, then you will have to pay a huge amount of brokerage.

insights.takeaway: Equity delivery trades often benefit from zero brokerage plans offered by discount brokers, but you must still pay DP (Depository Participant) charges per script when selling shares.
insights.quote: if you have bought the shares of 5 companies, then you will have to pay this charge 5 times

insights.takeaway: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) is higher for equity delivery (0.1% on sell) compared to intraday trading (0.025% on sell), which impacts your net profit margins.
insights.quote: in case of Equity Delivery, you will have to pay STT 0.1% on sell

insights.takeaway: Use online brokerage calculators provided by brokers to estimate exact net profits. Ensure you select your state to include variable stamp duty costs in your calculation.
insights.quote: I will tell you in 5 seconds how can you calculate all charges?

insights.takeaway: Contract notes are the most accurate way to verify all applicable charges, including state-specific stamp duty and DP charges, after a trade is executed.
insights.quote: if you have an Intraday Trader, then look at the contract note of Intraday

insights.takeaway: PPF is a highly secure, debt-based investment with a 15-year lock-in, while NPS is a market-linked retirement product that offers potentially higher returns through equity and bond exposure.
insights.quote: NPS has given a return of 8-10% Which is greater than PPF

insights.takeaway: PPF is considered the most secure investment in India because it is legally protected from court attachments, even in cases of personal debt or legal fines.
insights.quote: In a court case and the court has imposed a hefty fine on you... no one can touch it

insights.takeaway: NPS offers a unique tax advantage by allowing an additional deduction of Rs 50,000 under Section 80CCD(1B), over and above the Rs 1.5 lakh limit under Section 80C.
insights.quote: In-fact, you can calim an additional deduction of Rs.50,000

insights.takeaway: PPF follows an EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) tax structure, meaning contributions, interest, and maturity proceeds are all tax-free. NPS is EEE until maturity, where 40% of the corpus must be used for an annuity.
insights.quote: PPF comes in the exempt, exempt, exempt category

insights.takeaway: NPS allows for partial withdrawals of up to 25% of your own contributions after three years, whereas PPF allows a 50% withdrawal only after six years of regular contributions.
insights.quote: In NPS, after 3 year's contribution itself you can withdraw 25% of your deposited money

insights.takeaway: NPS provides the flexibility to choose your asset allocation between equity, corporate bonds, and government bonds, or select an auto-choice option to manage risk based on your age.
insights.quote: You have an option to allocate how much percentage of your funds will go into the stock market

insights.takeaway: NPS allows employers to contribute to an employee's account, a feature not available in PPF. This can be a tax-efficient way to build a retirement corpus through salary structuring.
insights.quote: If you want, you can ask your employer to contribute to your NPS

insights.takeaway: Filing an E-nomination for your PF account is mandatory to apply for a retirement pension and ensures your family can easily access your funds in case of an emergency.
insights.quote: unless you file E-nomination, you cannot apply for retirement pension

insights.takeaway: You can nominate multiple family members for your PF account. You must specify the percentage of the total PF amount each nominee should receive, ensuring the sum equals 100 percent.
insights.quote: if you are putting multiple nominees here i.e. 2 - 3... the sum total of all percentages should be 100%.

insights.takeaway: To complete the E-nomination process, you need the nominee's Aadhaar details, bank account number, IFSC code, and a digital photograph smaller than 100kb.
insights.quote: size of the photo should be less than 100kb

insights.takeaway: The final step of the E-nomination process requires E-KYC verification using your Aadhaar Virtual ID, which can be generated through the official UIDAI website.
insights.quote: By clicking on the E Sign option, you will see this screen It is written on screen that you want to do your E KYC using Aadhaar.

insights.takeaway: If you encounter errors while uploading nominee photos, use online photo compressor tools to reduce the file size to under 100kb while maintaining the required dimensions.
insights.quote: If this photo is more than 100kb then this kind of error will show up But if you reduce the size of your photo, then this photo will be uploaded very easily.

insights.takeaway: Absolute return only shows total profit on your investment. It ignores the time factor, making it a misleading metric for periodic investments like SIPs where money is invested at different times.
insights.quote: Absolute return can't indicate that this investment was profitable or not.

insights.takeaway: Use XIRR (Extended Internal Rate of Return) instead of CAGR or absolute returns when you have multiple, irregular cash inflows and outflows over time to get an accurate annualized performance.
insights.quote: When you invest multiple times, then the annualized return of that entire journey is known as IRR.

insights.takeaway: When calculating XIRR in Excel or Google Sheets, always use a negative sign for money going out (investments) and a positive sign for money coming in (redemptions).
insights.quote: I will enter with - Sign when I will invest. I will enter with + Sign when I will redeem.

insights.takeaway: Ensure your dates are formatted correctly in your spreadsheet software. If the software does not recognize the input as a date, the XIRR formula will return an error or inaccurate results.
insights.quote: We will not get the correct value if we enter random number in our XIRR formula.

insights.takeaway: IRR assumes annual intervals and requires zero-value entries for years with no transactions to remain accurate. XIRR is superior because it handles specific dates and ignores empty rows automatically.
insights.quote: If I don't enter zeros in the case of IRR then it will assume that I got that money in 8th year instead of 16th year.

insights.takeaway: When using investment calculators for planning, always use conservative return estimates (12-15%) rather than optimistic ones (20-25%) to ensure your financial goals remain realistic and achievable.
insights.quote: Calculate it for 12-15% which is believable and reasonable.

insights.takeaway: The XIRR shown in investment apps assumes you withdraw your entire corpus today. It annualizes the returns earned over the specific period you have held the investment, which explains high percentages on short-term gains.
insights.quote: XIRR always calculate annual returns.

insights.takeaway: In the early stages of your career, the highest return on investment comes from upskilling and networking rather than small SIPs. Focus on increasing your primary income first.
insights.quote: In the early stages of your career, you will be able to build massive wealth, when you invest. Not in stocks or mutual funds. But rather in yourself.

insights.takeaway: Businesses create wealth through scalability, allowing owners to earn while sleeping. Jobs are limited by your personal time, making them a less efficient way to build long-term wealth.
insights.quote: Businesses build wealth, not jobs!

insights.takeaway: Maintain an emergency fund covering 6 months of expenses for salaried employees and 12 months for freelancers. Keep this in liquid, low-risk instruments like liquid funds or FDs.
insights.quote: You must have expense money saved upto 6 months. So that you are able to look after the family obligations including paying off your loans, EMIs.

insights.takeaway: Protect your family's future with adequate health insurance and term life insurance. A term cover should be at least 20 times your annual income to clear debts and support dependents.
insights.quote: You should have adequate health insurance cover for every family member. It's premium will save you from such losses.

insights.takeaway: Avoid flat-rate interest loans, which often hide high effective interest rates. Always calculate the true cost of borrowing before taking a loan for depreciating assets like phones or cars.
insights.quote: The 10% loan comes equal to loan of reducing balance of 17 to 18%.

insights.takeaway: Buy-now-pay-later and credit cards can create a false sense of affordability. Only use credit if you can afford the item in full and have the discipline to avoid interest charges.
insights.quote: Never buy something you do not need. And always buy depreciating assets in full.

insights.takeaway: Only borrow money for assets that appreciate or generate cash flow, such as education or a vehicle used for business purposes. Avoid debt for lifestyle inflation.
insights.quote: If you are borrowing for assets that will appreciate or will generate a cash flow.

insights.takeaway: Do not make financial decisions based on social validation. High income does not guarantee happiness if your lifestyle expenses consume all your earnings and leave you in debt.
insights.quote: Hence, you must never do anything just to show it off to the society.

insights.takeaway: Your salary is not your taxable income. You can significantly reduce your tax liability by optimizing your salary structure with tax-exempt allowances before applying standard deductions.
insights.quote: Your salary is not equal to your income.

insights.takeaway: Always negotiate your CTC structure when joining a new company. Request your employer to bifurcate your salary into tax-exempt allowances like HRA, LTA, and uniform allowance to maximize take-home pay.
insights.quote: Whenever you join a new company, and there everything is negotiated, CTC is negotiated so, tell the company, please, the CTC you gave I accept that.

insights.takeaway: House Rent Allowance (HRA) is a powerful exemption. Even if you own a house, you can claim HRA if you are living in a rented property elsewhere, or if you live with your parents.
insights.quote: If you are not living in your rented place, but living with your parents, let's assume. So can you take the benefit of HRA? Absolutely.

insights.takeaway: Reimbursements for work-related expenses like internet, mobile, or home-office setup are not taxable. Submit actual bills to your employer instead of clubbing these costs into your taxable salary.
insights.quote: Whatever expenses you have done, on behalf of the company, if you are claiming them in the form of reimbursement, then, it is not taxable at all.

insights.takeaway: The New Tax Regime offers a higher rebate limit under Section 87A (up to Rs 7 lakhs income) compared to the Old Tax Regime (up to Rs 5 lakhs). Always compare both regimes before filing.
insights.quote: The rebate of 87A in the old tax regime you will get up to Rs. 5 lakh... And in the new tax regime, it is for Rs. 7 lakhs.

insights.takeaway: Maximize your 80D deduction by including health insurance premiums for yourself and your family, plus an additional Rs 5,000 for preventive health checkups, which can be paid in cash.
insights.quote: Against that also up to 5,000 rupees which you can pay in cash you can claim 5,000 rupees in this 80D.

insights.takeaway: Beyond the standard 80C limit of Rs 1.5 lakh, you can claim an additional Rs 50,000 deduction by investing in the National Pension System (NPS) under Section 80CCD(1B).
insights.quote: In NPS, additional the 1.5 lakh limit which you got of 80C over and above that if you can deposit 50,000 rupees, in additional NPS.

insights.takeaway: Gratuity and leave encashment are tax-exempt up to specific lifetime limits (Rs 20 lakhs and Rs 25 lakhs respectively). Ensure these are accounted for when planning your long-term tax strategy.
insights.quote: The gratuity which you get upto 20 lakhs, is tax exempt. This 20 lakhs is for the whole life span.

insights.takeaway: Salaried individuals with income from salary, one house property, and other sources like interest or family pension can file their taxes easily using the ITR-1 Sahaj form.
insights.quote: Income from salary, Income from one-house property and Income from other sources then you can file the ITR-1

insights.takeaway: Form-16 and Form-26AS are the two essential documents for filing ITR. Form-16 provides employer-specific details, while Form-26AS shows your overall income and tax deductions across all sources.
insights.quote: For that you have to refer to 2 forms the first is FORM-16 and the second is FORM-26AS

insights.takeaway: Always verify your personal details, including your phone number and email ID, on the Income Tax portal before starting the filing process to ensure smooth communication.
insights.quote: Before proceeding to return filing, check your personal information here Especially your phone number and email ID

insights.takeaway: While ITR forms often come with pre-filled data from your employer, you must manually add specific exempted allowances like LTA or HRA if they were not declared to your employer.
insights.quote: But you have to fill in the details of exemption allowance here manually.

insights.takeaway: Filing your return is not complete until you validate it. Even if your tax liability is zero, you must complete the validation process to finalize your ITR.
insights.quote: until validation does not occur ITR is not considered to be final so this step is very important

insights.takeaway: You must verify your ITR within 120 days of filing; otherwise, the return is considered invalid or nil. Aadhaar OTP is the most convenient method for verification.
insights.quote: If you haven't verified your return within 120 days, then it becomes nil

insights.takeaway: Effective tax planning starts at the beginning of the financial year, not during the filing process. Proactively managing your allowances helps minimize your tax liability.
insights.quote: your tax planning is Not while filing the return But it starts at the beginning of any financial year

insights.takeaway: Declare all your investments like 80C and 80D to your employer early. This ensures they appear in your Form-16, saving you from manual entry during tax filing.
insights.quote: whatever your investments are, 80C, 80D, any life insurance declare all to your employer

insights.takeaway: Lump sum investing involves putting all your capital into a mutual fund at once, whereas a Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) involves investing a fixed amount at regular intervals.
insights.quote: Lump Sum Investment. This means he put all his money at one time in Mutual Fund.

insights.takeaway: Timing the market with lump sum investments is risky because buying at a market peak significantly reduces the number of units you receive, potentially lowering your overall returns.
insights.quote: if he chose a bad day for his investment then he will get only 79 units.

insights.takeaway: SIPs help you avoid the risk of market timing by averaging your purchase price over time, as you buy units across different market highs and lows throughout the year.
insights.quote: SIP helps in avoiding market highs & lows and helps in getting Mutual Fund at a good average price.

insights.takeaway: SIPs are ideal for disciplined investing because they allow you to invest a portion of your monthly income without needing a large lump sum of capital upfront.
insights.quote: you can invest some percentage of that income & if you made SIP then you can make a disciplined investment.

insights.takeaway: You do not need a Demat account to invest in mutual funds; modern mobile applications allow you to start investing directly from your phone.
insights.quote: to invest in Mutual Fund you don't need to open Demat A/C.

insights.takeaway: Automating your SIP ensures consistency in your investment journey, and missing a payment typically incurs only minor bank charges rather than significant financial penalties.
insights.quote: you can automate your monthly SIP which means an amount will get deducted from the bank on a set date.

insights.takeaway: The e-Rupee is a sovereign-backed digital currency issued by the RBI. Unlike UPI or private wallets, it is a digital form of physical cash and acts as a legal tender.
insights.quote: e Rupee is a sovereign-backed currency. This means that RBI issues it.

insights.takeaway: e-Rupee is fungible, meaning it can be exchanged like physical cash. If you send a specific digital note to someone, they receive that exact token with its unique serial number.
insights.quote: My Rs 2 note went And Andy received the same note.

insights.takeaway: e-Rupee and UPI are currently separate systems. You cannot send e-Rupee directly to a standard UPI QR code, though the government plans to make them interchangeable in the future.
insights.quote: So now digital rupee and UPI are not linked together.

insights.takeaway: Unlike Bitcoin, which is decentralized and anonymous, the e-Rupee is centralized on a private blockchain controlled by the RBI, allowing the central bank to track transaction history.
insights.quote: RBI it's data and it's transactions They can see and control.

insights.takeaway: e-Rupee transactions are designed to be more energy-efficient than traditional card or online payment systems, reducing the overall cost of transaction verification.
insights.quote: To verify the transaction of e Rupee The energy that is spent, the electricity that is required That is relatively lesser.

insights.takeaway: The e-Rupee aims to bring unbanked individuals into the formal financial ecosystem, allowing them to transact digitally without necessarily needing a traditional bank account.
insights.quote: Through digital rupee They could be brought to the main banking ecosystem.

insights.takeaway: Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin are treated as digital assets in India and are subject to a 30% tax on profits, whereas the e-Rupee is legal tender and functions like cash.
insights.quote: wherein other cryptocurrencies in India Like how it's rate fluctuates That you sell and you get the profit Then, you need to pay a 30% tax on it.

insights.takeaway: Health insurance is essential to protect your long-term wealth from unexpected medical liabilities, ensuring you do not have to liquidate investments or take high-interest loans during emergencies.
insights.quote: Every person who wants to become rich in future... should always have health insurance.

insights.takeaway: Avoid policies with room rent caps that link other medical expenses to the room category. If your room rent exceeds the cap, insurers may proportionally reduce your entire claim payout.
insights.quote: If you are getting a claim of 50% of the room rent then you will get 50% of the claim for rest of the expenses.

insights.takeaway: Super top-up plans are superior to standard top-ups because they aggregate claims over the year. Once your deductible is crossed, subsequent claims are covered without needing to cross the deductible again.
insights.quote: Super top-up is a little kind and says that even once in a year If you have crossed your deductible then... I'll give you the claim.

insights.takeaway: Always opt for a PAN India policy over a Zonal policy if you live in a metro city. Zonal policies can trigger a co-pay penalty if you seek treatment in a city with a higher tier than your registered address.
insights.quote: If you are taking it in tier-3 city, then premium will be less and If you are taking it in tier-1 city then premium will be highest.

insights.takeaway: Use the annual free health check-up provided by your insurer to maintain a medical record. This helps prove that any future illness occurred after the policy start date, reducing claim rejection risks.
insights.quote: Every year get a free medical checkup and keep its reports in the files... this will prove that At the time of taking policy you were absolutely fit.

insights.takeaway: If you have a group insurance policy through your employer, convert it to an individual plan before leaving your job. This avoids new waiting periods and medical underwriting for a fresh policy.
insights.quote: Without cancelling it you can convert it into an individual plan... so that all your benefits will continue.

insights.takeaway: Prioritize insurers with a large network of cashless hospitals in your city. This ensures you do not have to pay large sums upfront during an emergency, which is critical for immediate treatment.
insights.quote: So a large network of cashless hospitals must be in your policy.

insights.takeaway: Your shares are held by depositories like CDSL or NSDL, not the broker. If a broker goes bankrupt, you can apply to the depository to transfer your holdings to another broker.
insights.quote: Your shares are stored in 2 places. Either CDSL or NSDL.

insights.takeaway: The Investor Protection Fund (IPF) provides a safety net for uninvested cash lying in your trading account, with a maximum claim limit of Rs 15 lakhs if a broker defaults.
insights.quote: SEBI has been formed for you Investor Protection Fund. Without any further delay if you complain then a maximum of up to Rs.15 lakhs can be claimed.

insights.takeaway: Always verify a broker's legitimacy by checking their SEBI registration number on the official SEBI website. Do not rely solely on the registration number displayed on a broker's website.
insights.quote: You have to enter it on the SEBI website and click on the GO button.

insights.takeaway: Never share your TPIN with anyone. This CDSL-issued code is required to authorize the sale of your shares, preventing brokers from selling your holdings without your explicit consent.
insights.quote: This ensures that your shares without your consent cannot be sold by the broker as you have the TPIN.

insights.takeaway: If you suspect your broker is engaging in unethical practices, such as unauthorized trading or forced recommendations, you can file a formal complaint directly through the SEBI SCORES portal.
insights.quote: If you feel that your broker has done something like this without asking you, you can complain to SEBI.

insights.takeaway: To minimize risk, avoid keeping large idle cash balances in your trading account. Transfer funds only when you intend to execute a purchase.
insights.quote: If you are making a long-term investment, then most of the time you will not keep a balance in your trading account.

insights.takeaway: When choosing a broker, evaluate the total cost of ownership, including account opening fees, Annual Maintenance Charges (AMC), and brokerage fees for your specific trading style.
insights.quote: It includes an Account Opening fee, AMC (Annual Maintenance Cost) or MMC (the Monthly Maintenance Cost) And Brokerage also.

insights.takeaway: A lower Net Asset Value (NAV) does not make a mutual fund cheaper or better. NAV is simply the price per unit, and returns are based on the percentage growth of your investment.
insights.quote: Whether the NAV is less or more, nothing makes a difference to your invested amount.

insights.takeaway: Avoid Dividend Mutual Funds if your goal is long-term wealth creation. These funds pay out regular income, which lowers the NAV and hinders the power of compounding.
insights.quote: If you want to grow your money exponentially, so Dividend Mutual Fund is not the right way.

insights.takeaway: Sectoral funds are high-risk and lack true diversification. Retail investors should stick to broader categories like Flexi-cap or Large-cap funds to ensure stable, diversified growth.
insights.quote: The speed at which sectoral funds grow, sectoral funds can also fall at the same speed.

insights.takeaway: Owning 15 to 20 mutual funds does not provide better diversification; it merely dilutes your returns to match the market average, effectively mimicking an index fund but with higher complexity.
insights.quote: Your overall portfolio return will also be it will be equal to the average return of all the companies in India.

insights.takeaway: Do not choose a mutual fund based solely on a low expense ratio. A fund with a slightly higher expense ratio that consistently delivers superior returns is better than a low-cost, average-performing fund.
insights.quote: Slightly higher expense ratio but very good returns are always better than very low expense ratio and average returns.

insights.takeaway: Frequent switching between mutual funds hurts long-term gains due to repeated capital gains tax payments. Staying invested allows your tax money to remain invested and grow over time.
insights.quote: It's like moving 3 steps forward and 1 step backward.

insights.takeaway: Becoming an insurance agent allows you to earn recurring income through renewal premiums. You can start by leveraging your existing network and providing consistent service to clients.
insights.quote: If you sell a policy once, As they keep paying premiums, your earning keeps increasing.

insights.takeaway: Working as a bike taxi driver for platforms like Ola or Uber offers flexible hours. You will need a commercial license, police verification, and a bike to get started.
insights.quote: You can earn from Rs 50 to Rs 150 - Rs 200 per ride.

insights.takeaway: Real estate or rent agency work can be highly lucrative. You can earn commissions from both landlords and tenants by facilitating property rentals or sales after building local trust.
insights.quote: In regards to the rent, The rent for the 1st month, you can earn approximately upto 100% from both parties.

insights.takeaway: Monetize your specialized skills like fitness, yoga, or swimming by offering one-on-one training sessions. Platforms like Urban Company can help you find clients in your area.
insights.quote: You can earn from Rs 2,000 upto Rs 10,000 - Rs 12,000 per hour.

insights.takeaway: Newspaper distribution remains a reliable morning side-hustle. You can earn through delivery commissions and by inserting pamphlets into papers for local businesses.
insights.quote: One hawker can sell easily up to 70 - 100 newspapers daily.

insights.takeaway: Event management offers flexible, short-term work opportunities. You can register with local event companies to assist with crowd management or vendor services during weddings and rallies.
insights.quote: You can earn from Rs 500 up to Rs 5,000 in one night.

insights.takeaway: Food delivery apps provide a low-barrier entry to part-time income. You only need a bike and a license to start, and you can toggle your availability based on your schedule.
insights.quote: You receive around Rs 33 - Rs 100 per delivery.

insights.takeaway: Utilize the Government of India's Skill India Programme to gain free or low-cost certifications in trades like plumbing or electrical work, which can be performed as freelance services.
insights.quote: Through Government of India's, Skill India Programme Several of these ITI courses are available free of cost.

insights.takeaway: The EPS pension formula is (Average Pensionable Salary multiplied by Years of Service) divided by 70. The average salary is calculated based on the last 60 months of service.
insights.quote: Average basic salary multiplied by the number of years of service divide by 70.

insights.takeaway: For pension calculations, the maximum pensionable salary (Basic + DA) is capped at ₹15,000 for service after September 2014, regardless of your actual higher salary.
insights.quote: Maximum considered for basic pension is maximum ₹ 15,000 after September 2014.

insights.takeaway: To be eligible for a monthly pension under the EPS scheme, you must complete at least 10 years of service, which is defined as 9 years and 6 months or more.
insights.quote: To be eligible for EPS Scheme, your minimum service year should be 10 years.

insights.takeaway: If your total service is less than 10 years, you are not eligible for a monthly pension, but you are entitled to withdraw your accumulated EPS contribution amount.
insights.quote: If your service is less than 10 years then you are not eligible to receive pension.

insights.takeaway: The PF department provides a 2-year bonus to your total service period if you have completed 20 or more years of service, up to a maximum cap of 35 years.
insights.quote: If your service is of 20 or more years, the PF department gives you 2 years bonus.

insights.takeaway: The maximum monthly pension currently payable under the EPS scheme is ₹7,500, calculated using the capped salary of ₹15,000 and the maximum service period of 35 years.
insights.quote: Your maximum pension becomes ₹ 7,500.

insights.takeaway: A Private Limited company provides limited liability, meaning your personal assets are protected from business debts and losses, unlike a sole proprietorship or partnership where personal assets are at risk.
insights.quote: The liability of a shareholder is limited to his shareholding capital.

insights.takeaway: In a Private Limited company, ownership and management can be separated. Shareholders own the company, while hired professionals or specific directors can manage daily operations.
insights.quote: The owner can be different from the one who is managing the work of the company.

insights.takeaway: Registering a Private Limited company requires a minimum of two directors and two shareholders, though one person can hold both roles simultaneously.
insights.quote: If you want to register a Private Limited Company then you need Min 2 Directors and 2 Shareholders.

insights.takeaway: Authorized capital is the maximum share capital a company can issue. It is best practice to keep some shares unissued so they can be offered to future investors without needing government approval.
insights.quote: It is a good practice to keep your shares unissued so that in future you can give them to any Investor.

insights.takeaway: Private Limited companies face double taxation on profits: the company pays corporate tax on profits, and shareholders pay personal income tax on any dividends received.
insights.quote: If Company had already given 25% Tax, Even after that, If profit share comes in your book, Then according to your tax slab, It will be imposed.

insights.takeaway: A Private Limited company is a highly regulated entity. It requires more compliance than other business forms, including mandatory annual filings, audits if turnover exceeds 5 crores, and adherence to MCA norms.
insights.quote: The Compliances of a Pvt. Ltd. Company is more than that of other forms of business entities.

insights.takeaway: Choose a Private Limited structure if you need to raise external funding, take on debt for risky ventures, or plan to sell stakes at high valuations. Avoid it for low-risk, organic, profitable businesses.
insights.quote: If your company is in a risky venture, where you have to take debt... then Pvt. Ltd. Company is the best option.

insights.takeaway: Freelancing is not a get-rich-quick scheme. It requires building a specific, marketable skill set and putting in significant effort to find and convert your first few clients.
insights.quote: ऐसा शॉर्टकट पैसा कमाने का बिल्कुल नहीं होता है

insights.takeaway: Leverage your existing network by asking friends and family if they know anyone needing your services. This is often the most effective way to land your first paid project.
insights.quote: मोस्ट पीपल दो नॉट लूज हिस फ्रेंड्स एंड फैमिली मतलब दो से पूछो कि ऐसा कोई किसी को जानते हो क्या

insights.takeaway: You do not need to be an expert to start. Identify skills you already have or are interested in, such as Excel, WordPress, or graphic design, and refine them to become marketable.
insights.quote: ऐसी बहुत सारी स्किल्स है जो आपकी नजरों के सामने बस आप उसको आइडेंटिफाई नहीं करते

insights.takeaway: When starting on platforms like Fiverr, offer a discount or a free sample to potential clients to prove your capability and build your initial portfolio of positive reviews.
insights.quote: मैं आपका फर्स्ट वीडियो एप्सलूटली प्रयोग को सेंड कर दूंगा आप देख कर मुझे बता देना

insights.takeaway: Use free resources like YouTube and FreeCodeCamp to learn skills from scratch. If you prefer a structured path to avoid confusion, consider paid courses on platforms like Udemy.
insights.quote: अगर आप बहुत सी चीज द्वितीय फ्रिकोडकैंप वांट समथिंग रिस्ट्रक्चर तो यू टेल मी

insights.takeaway: Don't just offer broad services. Create 'sub-niche' offerings, such as creating YouTube intros or specific animations, to stand out from the competition and command better pricing.
insights.quote: आपको यह ऐड करना पड़ेगा कि एक वीडियो एडिटर के पास क्या-क्या सब महसूस है

insights.takeaway: Freelancing requires more than just technical skill; you must learn how to market yourself, communicate with clients, and manage long-term professional relationships.
insights.quote: सिर्फ फोटोशॉप आना बहुत लोगों को अलग और शॉट तो बच्चों बच्चों को अश्लील फोटो शॉप आता है

insights.takeaway: Term insurance is essential for primary earners, those with significant loans, or anyone with dependents. It provides a financial safety net to ensure your family's survival if you pass away.
insights.quote: If you have an untimely death, then your income will also stop and in that case your family needs money for survival.

insights.takeaway: Purchase term insurance at a young age to lock in lower premiums. Premiums are based on your age and health status, and they remain fixed for the entire policy duration.
insights.quote: Because its premium depends on how young you are, how healthy and fit you are... once this policy is started, then the premium will never increase.

insights.takeaway: Avoid 'Return of Premium' or 'Limited Pay' options. These often double your premium; investing that extra money in mutual funds instead can yield significantly higher returns over the long term.
insights.quote: Return of premium is like that mutual fund which will return your money as it is after 38 years.

insights.takeaway: Do not over-complicate your policy with unnecessary riders. Focus on a base plan and only add essential riders like accidental disability or critical illness, ensuring they cover a sufficient term.
insights.quote: We should know, what we don't need because term insurance if it is the world's cheapest insurance, then it should be cheap.

insights.takeaway: Always answer health-related questions on insurance applications truthfully, especially regarding smoking or tobacco use. Lying to save on premiums can lead to claim rejection for your family later.
insights.quote: You have to give the answer truthfully... if the insurance company gets even the slightest hint, chances of claim rejection will increase.

insights.takeaway: Don't obsess over Claim Settlement Ratios (CSR). While a ratio above 99% is good, it doesn't reveal why claims are rejected. Stick to reputable, large insurance brands for reliability.
insights.quote: Claim settlement ratio tells how many claims the company has passed out of 100 it doesn't tell that the claims which are stopped are they stopped for the right reason?

insights.takeaway: Use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to analyze your insurance policy documents. Ask them to identify red flags or hidden terms to better understand your coverage and manage future expectations.
insights.quote: We can tell chat gpt that you read and tell me what are the red flags which I should know.

insights.takeaway: Sole proprietorships are ideal for low-risk, unorganized businesses like consulting or small shops because they require minimal compliance and no separate registration beyond basic certificates.
insights.quote: If your business is unorganized & has low risk, Where you don't need loans then you can go with a sole proprietorship.

insights.takeaway: In sole proprietorships and partnerships, promoters have unlimited liability, meaning personal assets can be seized to cover business losses. Pvt. Ltd., LLP, and OPC offer limited liability protection.
insights.quote: If a business incurred a loss of 10 lakhs and in businesses account there are only 5 lakhs, then rest of the 5 lakhs can be recovered from the sale of promoter's assets.

insights.takeaway: A Private Limited company is the mandatory structure for startups looking to raise external venture capital, issue ESOPs to employees, or scale internationally with high turnover.
insights.quote: Especially for the startups if they want to raise external funding, or want to give their employees ESOPs, Then Pvt. Ltd. company is the only option.

insights.takeaway: Partnership firms are excellent for testing a business model (MVP) with a co-founder due to their ease of formation and dissolution before committing to a formal Pvt. Ltd. structure.
insights.quote: For my first business to test it and my compatibility We formed a partnership firm.

insights.takeaway: One Person Company (OPC) allows a single promoter to maintain 100% control while enjoying limited liability, but it must convert to a Pvt. Ltd. if turnover exceeds 2 crores for three years.
insights.quote: A promoter who wants to Keep his liability limited, and want to keep 100% control to him, Then he can form an OPC.

insights.takeaway: Hindu Undivided Family (HUF) is a separate tax entity for Hindu, Jain, Sikh, and Buddhist families that allows for tax savings by utilizing individual tax rebates and splitting family business income.
insights.quote: From a tax perspective, HUF will be considered a separate tax entity, Which means HUF will also The same rebates which an individual gets.

insights.takeaway: When hiring employees, maintain and record attendance from day one using digital tools to ensure smooth compliance and avoid long-term legal or payroll disputes.
insights.quote: Whenever you form a business entity, the second you do is hiring, Interns & employees and when you hire them, You should manage and record their attendances.

insights.takeaway: You can apply for a fresh passport or reissue an existing one entirely online through the official Passport Seva portal by registering and filling out the application form.
insights.quote: पासपोर्ट तो ऑनलाइन बन जाता है बहुत इजी है

insights.takeaway: Choose between a normal passport and a tatkaal passport based on your urgency. Normal passports take 30 to 40 days, while tatkaal options are processed much faster for a higher fee.
insights.quote: नॉर्मल पासपोर्ट 1500 रुपये 30 से 40 दिन तक लग जाते हैं लेकिन तत्काल पासपोर्ट

insights.takeaway: Frequent travelers should opt for the 60-page booklet option during the application process to avoid running out of pages quickly.
insights.quote: अगर आप बहुत ज्यादा ट्रेवल करते हैं तो 60 पेजेस की बुकलेट रख सकते हैं

insights.takeaway: Always review the passport preview window carefully before final submission, as errors in personal information can lead to significant delays or rejection.
insights.quote: अपनी सारी इंफॉर्मेशन को एक बार चेक कर लेना ध्यान से क्योंकि यहां पे गलती होने की आशंका बहुत ज्यादा है

insights.takeaway: You can simplify the document submission process by using the DigiLocker integration to fetch your proof of birth and permanent address directly.
insights.quote: फेच फ्रॉम लॉकर पे क्लिक करना है

insights.takeaway: After completing the online payment and scheduling your appointment, ensure you carry both original documents and their photocopies to the Passport Seva Kendra.
insights.quote: पासपोर्ट सेवा केंद्र जाएं तो अपने ओरिजिनल डॉक्यूमेंट के साथ-साथ उनकी फोटोकॉपीज भी लेके जाइएगा

insights.takeaway: The passport issuance process involves two verification steps: an in-person visit to the Passport Seva Kendra followed by a physical police verification at your registered address.
insights.quote: पहले सेवा केंद्र जाके वेरिफिकेशन करवाओ फिर एक पुलिस वाला आपके घर वेरिफिकेशन करने आएगा

insights.takeaway: Keep your RTI application simple, concise, and objective. Avoid emotional narratives or lengthy backstories, as these make it harder for the Public Information Officer to process your request.
insights.quote: Keep your language simple and at the same time, keep your emotions afar.

insights.takeaway: If you have many questions, split them into multiple RTI applications with 3-5 questions each. This increases the likelihood of quick responses and maximizes potential penalties for delayed replies.
insights.quote: Let every RTI consist of 3, 4 or 5 questions. Let them get answered. File the next RTI.

insights.takeaway: Avoid over-ambitious requests covering decades of data. Narrow your request to a specific, manageable timeframe to ensure the department can retrieve the information without unnecessary delays.
insights.quote: If you need actual information, the amount of time that you require it for, the concise way that you need it, if you send that, you will get the information on time.

insights.takeaway: When filing an offline RTI, always keep a photocopy of your application and proof of submission, such as a received seal or a Speed Post receipt, to track the 30-day response timeline.
insights.quote: If you are sending it via Speed post, then keep it's receipt carefully so you are able to track.

insights.takeaway: Use the official rtionline.gov.in portal for central government departments. It allows you to file requests, track status, and even file a first appeal if you are dissatisfied with the response.
insights.quote: If you are not satisfied with your RTI disposal or you don't receive a reply within 30 days, then you can submit First Appeal here.

insights.takeaway: When drafting an RTI, always include your full contact details, including address, phone number, and email, to ensure the department can reach you with the requested information.
insights.quote: You need to make sure that you need to 'To' and 'From' very clearly and you need to write your communication detail.

insights.takeaway: When setting up a payroll sheet, include both employee name and father's name to ensure accurate identification if multiple employees share the same name.
insights.quote: If a company has multiple employees sharing a name, then they can be easily differentiated.

insights.takeaway: Always verify the total number of days in the specific month (e.g., 31 for March) when calculating pro-rata salary to ensure accurate pay calculations.
insights.quote: the month of march has 31 days the paydays can’t be more than 31 days.

insights.takeaway: ESI contributions are mandatory only for employees with a gross salary below 21,000 rupees per month. Ensure you filter or exclude those above this threshold.
insights.quote: It is only deducted for those employees whose salaries are less than 21,000.

insights.takeaway: Provident Fund (PF) deductions are typically calculated based on the Basic salary and Dearness Allowance (DA) only, excluding HRA and other incentives.
insights.quote: We know that PF is deducted on Basic and DA. We will not deduct PF on HRA and Incentive.

insights.takeaway: Calculate net salary by subtracting all statutory deductions (ESI, PF, TDS, Professional Tax) from the total earned salary, which includes basic pay and incentives.
insights.quote: We will subtract total deductions from total earned salary With this calculation, we will get the net salary in hand.

insights.takeaway: YouTube ad revenue is not based on subscriber count but on ad impressions. Creators earn 55% of the ad revenue collected by YouTube, which fluctuates based on economy, geography, and niche.
insights.quote: Money is not found on subscribers, nor is it found on the number of views but advertisements.

insights.takeaway: Ad revenue is significantly higher for viewers in countries with higher spending power, such as the US, compared to India, due to higher advertiser bidding for those audiences.
insights.quote: The people there earn more, spend more, have more spending power, so the marketing budget there is also more.

insights.takeaway: Content creators can increase their ad revenue by choosing 'ad-friendly' topics and keywords, as advertisers pay more to place ads on high-intent or premium-category videos.
insights.quote: Health Insurance... becomes a very good ad-friendly keyword.

insights.takeaway: Sponsorships are a primary income source where brands pay creators for dedicated or integrated promotions. Credibility and audience trust are key factors in determining the fee a creator can charge.
insights.quote: Brands thought that instead of running random ads on YouTube, why don't we give money to the creators.

insights.takeaway: Affiliate marketing allows creators to earn commissions by recommending products without needing upfront sponsorship money, providing a more independent and recurring revenue stream.
insights.quote: In sponsorship the creator gets upfront money to make a video. there is nothing like this in affiliate.

insights.takeaway: To ensure long-term sustainability, creators should prioritize building their own products (digital or physical) to reduce dependency on external sponsors and volatile ad market conditions.
insights.quote: This is the prime focus of any creator That how can he generate revenue from his own products.

insights.takeaway: Running a professional content creation business involves high operational costs, including expensive equipment, studio infrastructure, production teams, and travel, which must be deducted from revenue to determine actual profit.
insights.quote: Whatever is left after doing all this is the profit.

insights.takeaway: Resignation is the voluntary act of an employee leaving a company, whereas termination is initiated by the employer due to performance issues, misconduct, or economic factors.
insights.quote: Resignation, which means that an employee is leaving a company by his own wish.

insights.takeaway: The notice period, typically 15 days to 3 months, is a contractual obligation meant for clearing dues, returning company assets, and transferring knowledge to successors.
insights.quote: In this notice period it is a responsibility of an employee that he clear all his dues.

insights.takeaway: Employers can legally terminate an employee for misconduct like theft, fraud, or insubordination. In such cases, the employee is typically not entitled to a severance package.
insights.quote: If any employee is guilty of willful insubordination or disobedience... in all these cases this gives the employer a right to terminate.

insights.takeaway: Under the Industrial Disputes Act, workmen terminated for unavoidable reasons (not misconduct) are generally entitled to a severance package, often calculated based on basic salary and DA.
insights.quote: If because of any unavoidable reason or without any mistake of the employee he is being terminated then in this case severance package should be given.

insights.takeaway: Companies often prefer asking employees to resign rather than terminating them to avoid legal complexities, allowing the employee to maintain a clean record for future job prospects.
insights.quote: Most of the companies try to request their employees to resign instead of directly terminating them.

insights.takeaway: While you cannot be forced to work, leaving without serving a notice period can lead to claims for compensation if the company suffers losses or legal action if company property is withheld.
insights.quote: If a company is incurring a loss because of it, then the company can ask for compensation from you.

insights.takeaway: Absconding, leaving without notice, is damaging to your career. It complicates PF/ESI exit dates, delays final settlements, and can lead to termination for unauthorized absence.
insights.quote: If your PF and ESI are being deducted then its exit dates will not be exact and at that time harassment will happen.

insights.takeaway: Avoid buying the latest version of smartphones immediately upon launch. Buying older models after a price drop can save you significant money without sacrificing essential features.
insights.quote: I try my best to purchase the previous version of the new phone available in the market.

insights.takeaway: Recurring Deposits (RD) are a simple, disciplined way to invest monthly, similar to SIPs in mutual funds, and offer the benefit of fixed interest rates even if market rates fall.
insights.quote: If you invest SIP in FD every month. It is known as 'Recurring Deposit' or RD.

insights.takeaway: Prioritize quality and fit over brand logos when buying clothing. Basic, unbranded items are often more durable, versatile, and significantly cheaper than luxury-branded alternatives.
insights.quote: If you are purchasing branded or luxury clothes, then the major proportion of your money.. You aren't paying for the fabric nor the fit, but for the logo.

insights.takeaway: Cars are rapidly depreciating assets. Buying a 2 to 3-year-old pre-owned vehicle can save you a large percentage of the initial cost compared to buying a brand-new car.
insights.quote: In the next 2 to 3 years, it's price will reduce from 50% to 60%.

insights.takeaway: Renting a home can provide financial flexibility and freedom, especially if the rent is a small percentage of the property value, allowing you to relocate or change lifestyle without debt obligations.
insights.quote: As soon as you purchase a house, especially on EMI. So then you will be legally obligated to the house.

insights.takeaway: Small, recurring daily expenses like bottled water, cigarettes, or daily snacks compound into significant amounts over a year, hindering your long-term wealth creation.
insights.quote: In a purely financial sense, these daily or weekly addictions will take you far behind in the journey of creating wealth.

insights.takeaway: Avoid expensive club memberships for networking or lifestyle purposes. You can often access the same facilities for a fraction of the cost through guest passes or individual memberships.
insights.quote: Even if you are using the facilities daily. Even then it doesn't make any financial sense to pay such a huge amount to any club.

insights.takeaway: Be cautious of 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' offers and online checkout add-ons like extended warranties or donations, as they often lead to unnecessary spending on items you did not intend to buy.
insights.quote: You might think, Oh! You saved ₹1000. But you still had to spend ₹2,000. Did you even want those three t-shirts?

insights.takeaway: The Income Tax Department now uses Statement of Financial Transactions (SFT) to track high-value spending, such as large donations, hotel bills, and insurance premiums, directly linking them to your PAN.
insights.quote: Under this government has the power to direct big financial institutions like Banks and even companies to provide the information

insights.takeaway: Faceless Assessment and Appeal systems eliminate physical interaction with tax officers, reducing corruption and harassment by assigning cases to officers in different cities via a central computer.
insights.quote: Neither you can bribe him, nor he can harass you.

insights.takeaway: Form 26AS is a critical document that aggregates your financial data. Always verify that your claimed deductions match the entries in this form to avoid scrutiny or tax notices.
insights.quote: It consists of all your details which are with the income tax department.

insights.takeaway: The government is increasingly using data matching to identify discrepancies between your reported income and your lifestyle expenses, making it difficult to hide unauthorized income.
insights.quote: The system itself notice the mismatching of your expenditure and substantial income.

insights.takeaway: Claiming tax deductions for expenses you did not actually incur is now high-risk, as the government tracks financial transactions through SFT and will flag mismatches in your ITR.
insights.quote: if you have claimed the amount,& it's not there in 26AS, then you won't be getting any deduction for that, instead, you will be facing an inquiry for this.

insights.takeaway: The Taxpayer Charter protects you from arbitrary raids or seizures, requiring officers to have solid proof before initiating scrutiny, provided you are not involved in major financial crimes.
insights.quote: an income tax officer cannot harass you unless he is having some solid proof against you

insights.takeaway: Always verify the sender's email address before clicking links. Official communications from companies like YouTube or Google will always come from their specific, verified domain, not random addresses.
insights.quote: Check out the sender's email id. Understand and think.

insights.takeaway: Never pay an advance fee for a job, lottery win, or inheritance. Legitimate employers and organizations will never ask you to pay a security deposit or processing fee to receive a benefit.
insights.quote: Whenever someone asks for advance in exchange for job take my guarantee, that will surely be a fake one.

insights.takeaway: Check the domain name carefully in your browser. Culprits often use slight misspellings or subdomains to mimic official websites like Flipkart or banks to steal your login credentials.
insights.quote: The word that comes before the top level domain is the most important name on any website.

insights.takeaway: Prioritize websites that use HTTPS. While not a guarantee of safety, the absence of an SSL certificate or a 'Not Secure' warning in your browser is a major red flag for phishing sites.
insights.quote: If website is starting with HTTP then it means it is bad and if it starts with HTTPS then it means it is good.

insights.takeaway: Official Indian government websites almost exclusively use .gov.in or .nic.in domains. Be extremely skeptical of any site claiming to be a government portal that uses other extensions.
insights.quote: Almost 99% of the government websites have just two domains that is gov.in or nic.in.

insights.takeaway: Be wary of excessive advertisements on websites claiming to be official government portals. Legitimate government sites do not use third-party ads to generate revenue.
insights.quote: You won't find many ads on the government website. Our government isn't facing such bad days.

insights.takeaway: Use reputable antivirus or anti-malware software on your devices. Many modern security suites include 'bank mode' or 'safe browsing' features that protect your data when accessing sensitive financial accounts.
insights.quote: In many antivirus software, there is a safe browsing mode and bank mode through which when you go to a bank... you can turn on the safe browsing mode.

insights.takeaway: Pension withdrawal is calculated using Table D of the EPS 1995 scheme based on your years of service and exit wages, not just the total amount contributed to your pension fund.
insights.quote: You will get pension withdrawal according to EPS 1995, table D

insights.takeaway: Service duration is rounded for pension calculations: 6 months or more is rounded up to the next year, while less than 6 months is rounded down to zero, making you ineligible for withdrawal.
insights.quote: If you are having a service of 5 yrs 7 months Then it will be round of to 6 yrs

insights.takeaway: Pension contributions are capped at 8.33% of Rs 15,000 (Rs 1,250 per month). If your passbook shows higher monthly pension contributions, it is likely an error that could cause settlement issues.
insights.quote: Maximum EPS contribution should be rupees 1250 and not more than this

insights.takeaway: There is no interest earned on pension fund contributions. Interest is only applicable to the Provident Fund (PF) portion of your account.
insights.quote: Keep a check on the fact that there is no interest on pension shares.

insights.takeaway: When transferring PF accounts, only service history is carried forward. No actual money is transferred between pension accounts, so a zero balance in the new passbook is normal.
insights.quote: Whenever we transfer pension from one account to another Only service history gets transferred and no actual money is transferred

insights.takeaway: If your pension settlement amount is incorrect, file a formal PF grievance. Clearly state the expected versus received amount and attach your passbook as evidence of the discrepancy.
insights.quote: It’s possible then kindly attach the copy of your passbook So that the PF department could know

insights.takeaway: You cannot withdraw advances from your pension fund. Any advance must be taken from the PF balance, and no TDS is deducted when withdrawing the pension corpus.
insights.quote: On any day when you are withdrawing your money from your pension. No TDS will be deducted from it

insights.takeaway: Credit cards offer rewards and interest-free periods up to 45 days, making them useful for company-reimbursed expenses or tracking monthly spending, provided the full balance is paid on time.
insights.quote: If you pay from credit card you will get rewards.

insights.takeaway: Credit card debt is the most expensive form of borrowing, with annual interest rates often reaching 40 percent or more, far exceeding returns from typical investments like mutual funds or PF.
insights.quote: It may go to 40-42% per annum.

insights.takeaway: Missing credit card payments damages your CIBIL score, which can lead to higher interest rates on future essential loans like home or education loans.
insights.quote: If you delay your credit card payment then your credit score is damaged.

insights.takeaway: Always read the fine print in credit card terms and conditions, as banks may reserve the right to increase interest rates if you delay payments or violate specific clauses.
insights.quote: It is important to read the terms and conditions.

insights.takeaway: Paying only the 'minimum amount due' on a credit card is a trap that extends your debt for months or years while accumulating massive interest charges for the bank.
insights.quote: The more delay you do in paying 10,000 the more the company will earn.

insights.takeaway: Unlike home or education loans which can lead to asset creation or future income, credit cards are typically used for depreciating assets, making them a poor financial tool for wealth building.
insights.quote: Whatever you buy it's value depreciates fast.

insights.takeaway: Credit cards can encourage overspending by creating a false sense of having extra money, which undermines financial discipline and leads to a cycle of debt.
insights.quote: Credit card does not teach you self control or better financial discipline.

insights.takeaway: Do not judge a stock's potential by its price per share. Focus on percentage growth and the company's business performance rather than buying cheap penny stocks to accumulate more units.
insights.quote: We are not earning on number of shares But on the percentage growth.

insights.takeaway: A high share price does not mean a company is expensive or cannot grow further. Market capitalization is the true measure of a company's size, not the individual share price.
insights.quote: It depends on what percentage of ownership you are getting over A share.

insights.takeaway: Portfolio returns are the net result of winners minus losers. Prioritize capital preservation and avoid fundamentally weak penny stocks, as they often destroy the gains made by quality stocks.
insights.quote: The first and most important priority in investing is that how you preserve your capital.

insights.takeaway: Beware of 'insider news' or tips on unknown companies. These are often traps where promoters inflate prices to dump shares on retail investors before the price crashes.
insights.quote: If anytime you are getting that insider news then you should know that it is told to you intentionally.

insights.takeaway: Do not sell a winning stock simply because it has doubled. If the company's future remains bright, holding onto winners is the only way to achieve multi-bagger returns.
insights.quote: Selling it just because of thinking that it has gained 100% is not right.

insights.takeaway: Stock market investing requires a long-term horizon of 10 to 15 years. Significant wealth is built by allowing businesses time to grow, not through short-term speculation.
insights.quote: You should be ready to wait for at least 10-15 years as nothing is going to happen before it.

insights.takeaway: Publicly available news is already priced into the market. Successful investing is based on your unique interpretation of a company's long-term story rather than reacting to current data.
insights.quote: Investment can never be right on the basis of news or data as everybody has it.

insights.takeaway: Invest a meaningful amount in the stock market relative to your net worth. Investing a negligible percentage of your savings will not significantly impact your overall financial growth.
insights.quote: At a minimum, you should invest that much money that if your investment goes right it affects Your net worth.

insights.takeaway: Never use borrowed money or margin leverage to invest in the stock market. It is extremely risky and can lead to total capital loss if the market moves against you.
insights.quote: Never invest in the stock market by taking loan, leverage Margin.

insights.takeaway: PF interest is calculated on a monthly running balance basis. You earn interest on your contributions starting from the month following the deposit, not the month of the deposit itself.
insights.quote: PF interest is credited on a monthly running basis

insights.takeaway: You only earn interest on the employee and employer PF shares. No interest is accrued on the pension fund contribution portion of your total PF account balance.
insights.quote: you will never get the interest on this PF contribution

insights.takeaway: PF interest is calculated for the wage period of March to February. If you withdraw or transfer your funds mid-year, you are entitled to interest calculated up to the date of withdrawal.
insights.quote: whenever you have either withdrawn or transferred PF money At that time PF office will credit your interest till that date.

insights.takeaway: If you withdraw your PF balance before the 25th of a month, you lose interest for that entire month. Withdrawals made on or after the 25th earn interest for that month.
insights.quote: If you withdraw your PF money before 25th So you will not get any interest on it for that current month.

insights.takeaway: An account becomes inoperative if no claim is made within 36 months after retirement at 58, migration abroad, or death. You stop earning interest on inoperative accounts.
insights.quote: if you let the money remain in PF So till the age of 61 will get the interest, after that, the interest will stop

insights.takeaway: If an employer deposits your PF contribution late, you are still entitled to interest from the original due date. The PF office recovers this interest from the employer as damages.
insights.quote: if the employer will deposit money after 2-3 years, Suppose he is depositing money for 2016-17 now. So the interest that you will get is from 2016-17

insights.takeaway: If the current year's interest rate is not yet notified, the PF office uses the previous financial year's rate for any full and final settlements processed during that period.
insights.quote: the interest you will get will be based on the rate of the previous financial year

insights.takeaway: The government has introduced three new EPFO-linked schemes (A, B, and C) to incentivize employment, offering benefits for both freshers and experienced employees with a salary limit of up to INR 1 lakh.
insights.quote: The salary criteria has been increased from INR 15,000 to INR 1L per month.

insights.takeaway: Scheme A provides a one-month wage subsidy of up to INR 15,000 to first-time employees entering the workforce, paid in three installments directly into their EPFO account.
insights.quote: It's primary benefit is one month's salary of INR 15,000 as a subsidy.

insights.takeaway: Under Scheme A, if a new employee leaves their job within 12 months, the employer is legally required to refund the INR 15,000 subsidy received by the employee.
insights.quote: This will need to be refunded If the employment ends within 12 months.
