insights.takeaway: Scheme B incentivizes manufacturing sector growth by providing a 24% wage subsidy (capped at INR 6,000 per month) split between the employer and employee for up to 4 years.
insights.quote: 50% will be provided to the employee, 50% will be provided to the employer.

insights.takeaway: To qualify for Scheme B or C, employers must meet specific hiring thresholds, such as hiring at least 50 new employees or increasing their workforce by 25% over the previous year's baseline.
insights.quote: Employer must hire atleast the following number of previously non EPFO enrolled workers.

insights.takeaway: Scheme C provides employers a subsidy of up to INR 3,000 per month for 2 years toward the employer's share of PF contributions for each additional employee hired.
insights.quote: The government will reimburse upto INR 3,000 per month, for 2 years towards the EPFO contribution.

insights.takeaway: Be cautious of potential liquidity issues; government PF schemes often restrict withdrawal of funds until the scheme period concludes to prevent fraudulent claims.
insights.quote: Once the scheme is over, you can withdraw the money. But during the scheme, you can't withdraw the money.

insights.takeaway: Employers opting for these schemes should maintain rigorous compliance records, as government audits and inspections are common and can lead to account locking if discrepancies are found.
insights.quote: Please keep your compliance level super high.

insights.takeaway: NPS and APY are both retirement schemes, but you generally do not need to invest in both because their returns and pension outcomes are mathematically similar.
insights.quote: The answer to our question of whether we should open an account in both is no.

insights.takeaway: NPS offers greater flexibility than APY, allowing you to increase your contributions as your income grows and providing higher potential for building a larger retirement corpus.
insights.quote: In my opinion, you should go for NPS because it is a lot more flexible.

insights.takeaway: APY is specifically designed for the unorganized sector and individuals who cannot afford the minimum monthly contributions required for NPS.
insights.quote: APY is made for people who cannot afford to invest more than Rs 500 in NPS.

insights.takeaway: NPS allows for partial withdrawals of up to 25% of your own contributions after three years for specific reasons, whereas APY does not permit voluntary withdrawals.
insights.quote: In NPS after investing for 3 years, You can withdraw 25% of your contribution.

insights.takeaway: While APY has a fixed, capped pension of Rs 5,000, NPS allows you to scale your investment significantly, potentially leading to much higher monthly pensions upon retirement.
insights.quote: If you want to make a bigger investment, upon investing Rs 2350 then you will get a pension of Rs 14,000.

insights.takeaway: The power of compounding is most effective when you start investing early. Even small, consistent investments made early in your career significantly impact your final retirement corpus.
insights.quote: The power of compounding dictates that you should start earlier and invest longer to receive bigger amounts.

insights.takeaway: NPS provides tax benefits under Section 80C and an additional deduction of Rs 50,000 under Section 80CCD(1B), allowing for a total deduction of up to Rs 2,00,000.
insights.quote: You can get a deduction of Rs 1,50,000 in NPS and APY both.

insights.takeaway: To withdraw your EPF money, you must have an activated UAN and your KYC details updated on the EPFO portal.
insights.quote: you will not be able to withdraw that money if in your UAN Account, the KYC is not updated.

insights.takeaway: The three essential documents for EPF KYC are your Aadhar card for identity, bank account for fund transfers, and PAN card for tax purposes.
insights.quote: you need to submit three documents. First is Aadhar Number, Second is Bank Account Number and the third one is your PAN card.

insights.takeaway: Submitting your PAN card to the EPFO portal is mandatory to avoid TDS deduction on your PF withdrawal if your total service period is less than five years.
insights.quote: PAN card number is important so that no TDS gets deducted on this amount. especially if your service period is five years or less.

insights.takeaway: Updating your KYC on the member portal is only the first step. You must ensure your employer digitally approves these details to make them valid for services.
insights.quote: getting the KYC is not enough, You also have to get it approved.

insights.takeaway: Digital approval of KYC is performed by your employer using their digital signature. If pending, you may need to coordinate with them to complete the process.
insights.quote: The digital approval process is done by your employer.

insights.takeaway: Once your KYC is digitally approved by your employer, you gain access to online services like PF claims and balance transfers without manual intervention.
insights.quote: After your KYC gets approved. You can avail all these online services here, without any issue.

insights.takeaway: NPS is a retirement-focused investment scheme that offers tax benefits under the EEE category, meaning contributions, returns, and withdrawals are largely tax-free.
insights.quote: And this comes under Exempt, Exempt, Exempt Category.

insights.takeaway: NPS returns are market-linked and variable, unlike fixed-income schemes like PPF or EPF, but historical data shows returns typically range between 8-10 percent.
insights.quote: If I talk in regards to the past 10 years, then NPS has given returns between 8-10%

insights.takeaway: You can claim an additional tax deduction of INR 50,000 under Section 80CCD(1B) over and above the standard INR 1.5 lakh limit available under Section 80C.
insights.quote: You can claim an additional deduction of INR 50,000/- more. Section 80CCD: Under Sub Section 1B

insights.takeaway: NPS offers two investment modes: Active Choice, where you decide the asset allocation percentage, and Auto Choice, which automatically adjusts risk based on your age.
insights.quote: There are 2 options for you, either you choose Active Choice... or else you can choose Auto Choice

insights.takeaway: NPS Tier 1 is a retirement account with a lock-in until age 60, whereas Tier 2 is a flexible account with no lock-in but lacks the tax benefits of Tier 1.
insights.quote: There is no lock-in period for you. You can invest as much as you want and withdraw whenever you want.

insights.takeaway: Premature withdrawal of up to 25 percent of your own contributions is permitted after 3 years for specific reasons like medical emergencies, education, or house purchase.
insights.quote: For Premature Withdrawal, you need to regularly contribute for 3 years. After that, you can withdraw 25% of your own contribution.

insights.takeaway: Upon reaching age 60, you must use at least 40 percent of your accumulated NPS corpus to purchase an annuity, which provides a regular monthly pension.
insights.quote: And the remaining 40%, you need to compulsorily buy an Annuity from an Insurance Provider

insights.takeaway: Employers can contribute to an employee's NPS account, and this contribution is treated as a business expense, allowing for additional tax deductions under Section 80CCD(2).
insights.quote: Employer provides, he shows it as a Business Expense, and claim it as a Tax for his company.

insights.takeaway: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) allows parents to open an account for a girl child under 10 years old, with a maximum of two accounts per family, or three in case of twins.
insights.quote: there is an age CAP of a daughter up to 10 years

insights.takeaway: SSY requires investments for only 15 years, but the account matures at 21 years. Starting the account as early as possible is crucial to ensure funds are available for marriage or education.
insights.quote: the maturity of this account is 21 years

insights.takeaway: To maximize interest earnings, ensure your monthly deposit is credited to the SSY account before the 10th of each month, as interest is calculated based on the balance between the 10th and the end of the month.
insights.quote: the cut-off date of getting interest is 10th of every month

insights.takeaway: SSY offers a triple tax benefit: the principal investment is deductible under Section 80C, the interest earned is tax-free, and the final maturity amount is also exempt from tax.
insights.quote: you'll get a deduction in 80C for the money you'll invest

insights.takeaway: Unlike some other schemes, you cannot take a loan against the balance in an SSY account. Premature withdrawal is restricted to specific cases like the death of the guardian or life-threatening diseases.
insights.quote: you cannot get any loan against the money kept in Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana

insights.takeaway: Once the girl reaches 18 years of age, you are permitted to make a partial withdrawal of up to 50% of the account balance specifically for her higher education expenses.
insights.quote: when she'll be 18 years old in that case, you can withdraw 50% amount

insights.takeaway: SSY generally offers an interest rate 0.5% higher than the Public Provident Fund (PPF), making it a highly attractive long-term savings vehicle for a daughter's future.
insights.quote: it's always 0.5% ahead of the PPF

insights.takeaway: Use watchlists to group stocks by sector or interest. This allows you to track specific companies without searching for them individually every time you open your trading app.
insights.quote: I don't need to search again and again for those stocks to track them.

insights.takeaway: A 'Market' order executes immediately at the current trading price, while a 'Limit' order allows you to set a specific price at which you are willing to buy or sell.
insights.quote: If I want to buy it only on my desirable price Then I will change MARKET to the LIMIT option.

insights.takeaway: Choose 'Delivery' mode when buying shares if you intend to hold them for the long term. This often incurs zero brokerage fees compared to intraday trading.
insights.quote: Delivery means I want to hold stocks for long time. Brokerage will be also 0 in that case.

insights.takeaway: After Market Orders (AMO) allow you to place buy or sell requests outside of standard market hours (9:15 AM to 3:30 PM), which will execute when the market opens next.
insights.quote: When you select AMO Your order can be placed even after 3:30 PM.

insights.takeaway: Set price alerts to receive notifications when a stock hits your target buy or sell price. This helps you monitor opportunities without constantly watching the live charts.
insights.quote: I will click on the Watch icon and will set an alert.

insights.takeaway: Before investing, research a company's debt levels, past performance, and future business model. A debt-free company is generally considered a safer long-term investment.
insights.quote: The stock we bought today was a debt-free company. So, that company has 0 debt which is a plus point.

insights.takeaway: Stay updated on macroeconomic factors like crude oil prices, government policies, and currency fluctuations, as these significantly impact stock market performance across different sectors.
insights.quote: Many factors affect the stock Like dollar-rupees relation, Crude oil prices, Any government policy.

insights.takeaway: To validate a product idea, launch a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in small quantities to test market acceptance, gather user feedback, and iterate before scaling production.
insights.quote: The objective of the MVP product was that does the people accept this product?

insights.takeaway: Customer buying decisions are driven by five primary factors: value for money, payment options (including COD), delivery time, assistance/nudge marketing, and authentic reviews.
insights.quote: A customer will buy any product or not depends on 5 primary factors.

insights.takeaway: Offering Cash on Delivery (COD) is essential for e-commerce in India, as many customers prefer it. If your website lacks COD, you may lose sales to marketplaces like Amazon or Flipkart.
insights.quote: This cash on delivery is important, Do you know how we realized it? From Flipkart and Amazon's sales.

insights.takeaway: Use platforms like Shopify for e-commerce to access better analytics, inventory management, and customer data, which are crucial for scaling compared to basic website builders.
insights.quote: We get very good analytics here. So that's why we shifted majorly.

insights.takeaway: When running paid ads, track your Cost Per Click (CPC) and conversion rates to determine your customer acquisition cost. Focus on the view-to-payment ratio rather than just total ad views.
insights.quote: If you bring 100 people on your website and suppose 3% people buy it, then there are 3 sales.

insights.takeaway: Influencer marketing can be highly effective if you use a performance-based model, such as providing a unique discount code to track sales and paying a commission per unit sold.
insights.quote: We told them that if you can make a video of it, then please do And in return, we will give you a certain amount per sale.

insights.takeaway: When managing logistics, avoid over-complicating by using too many courier partners. Select a few reliable partners that cover your required pin codes to ensure smooth pickups and reduce delays.
insights.quote: The major problem that occurred was that we had hired too many delivery partners.

insights.takeaway: CTC is not a legal term defined in Indian labour laws. It is a company-calculated figure that includes statutory benefits, which may not reflect the actual cash you receive monthly.
insights.quote: In any labour law act, CTC is not mentioned.

insights.takeaway: Always negotiate your salary based on gross or in-hand figures rather than CTC. CTC often includes components like gratuity that you only receive after long-term service.
insights.quote: Whenever you are negotiating with the company do not negotiate on CTC.

insights.takeaway: A reliable thumb rule for lower salary brackets is that your in-hand monthly salary will be approximately 70% of the offered CTC, meaning 30% goes toward various deductions.
insights.quote: If anyone is giving me CTC... I can deduct 30%.

insights.takeaway: Gratuity is often included in CTC, but you are only eligible to receive it if you complete at least five years of continuous service with the employer.
insights.quote: If your company has included gratuity in your CTC then be sure that you have to complete 5 years there.

insights.takeaway: In labour law deductions, lower-income employees often face a higher percentage of deductions relative to their CTC compared to higher-income employees.
insights.quote: In labour laws lower income group money is charged and higher income group is exempted.

insights.takeaway: Understand the hierarchy of salary terms: CTC is the highest amount, followed by gross salary, and finally net salary, which is the actual cash in-hand you receive.
insights.quote: Topmost is your CTC, it is the most. After that it is gross and lowest is your net or cash in-hand.

insights.takeaway: If a job or investment scheme promises returns that seem too good to be true or asks for money upfront, it is almost certainly a scam.
insights.quote: If you are getting better than expected results somewhere, then most probably, it will be a scam.

insights.takeaway: Never share your UPI PIN to receive money. A PIN is only required to authorize a payment from your account, never to receive funds.
insights.quote: Never need to insert a pin to receive the money.

insights.takeaway: Avoid investing in Co-operative banks for higher interest rates. They are often poorly regulated and carry a high risk of capital loss compared to nationalized or large private banks.
insights.quote: If you are looking for FD then avoid Co-Operative banks.

insights.takeaway: Legitimate companies never charge candidates for job applications, resume verification, or security deposits. Any request for money before or during the hiring process is a red flag.
insights.quote: If anyone asks you for money before giving a job it is fake.

insights.takeaway: Data entry scams often use fake legal threats and notarized contracts to intimidate victims into paying 'compensation' for alleged errors. These contracts are legally void and unenforceable.
insights.quote: The law does not consider it legal so, it is null and void from the beginning.

insights.takeaway: Avoid falling for the 'sunk cost fallacy' in scams. If you have already lost money, do not pay more in hopes of recovering your initial investment, as scammers will continue to exploit this.
insights.quote: It is like for those people that after being trapped, something like loss aversion in that.

insights.takeaway: Scammers often use fake websites and fabricated credentials, such as stealing photos of real executives from LinkedIn, to build false credibility for their schemes.
insights.quote: I searched for the photo, I came to know that this photo is on one LinkedIn profile.

insights.takeaway: Employees who left service before 2014 and lack a UAN can now have one generated by their former employer using the unified portal's new allotment feature.
insights.quote: this new feature of PF is only on the employers portal now

insights.takeaway: To generate a UAN for an old PF account, the employer must log into the unified portal, select 'UAN allotment for existing member', and update missing exit details.
insights.quote: go to the last option UAN allotment for existing member

insights.takeaway: When generating a UAN for legacy employees, you must provide accurate exit dates and reasons from company records, as this data was often not digitized for pre-2014 accounts.
insights.quote: the information you have to mention which you will get from company records

insights.takeaway: Once an employer approves the UAN allotment, the generated UAN number becomes immediately available for the employee to activate and use for online PF services.
insights.quote: your UAN has been successfully allocated

insights.takeaway: For very old employees whose records were maintained offline, you may need to manually input personal details like gender and date of birth before the UAN can be generated.
insights.quote: you have to fetch this information from the employee

insights.takeaway: Having a UAN is essential for accessing online PF services, including balance checks, passbook downloads, and withdrawal requests, which are unavailable with only a PF number.
insights.quote: employees could not take the online services such as They cannot withdraw

insights.takeaway: Your UAN remains constant across employers, but each new job generates a unique PF number. You must transfer your old PF balance to your current active account to ensure seamless withdrawals.
insights.quote: Your current active PF Number is the latest PF Number that is active And the old ones as and when you leave the Company, it keeps deactivating.

insights.takeaway: Do not panic if your Pension Fund balance appears as zero in your new PF passbook after a transfer. The pension amount is not physically transferred like the PF balance.
insights.quote: If your overall PF Amount has been transferred and the Pension Amount has not been transferred, then you don't have to worry about anything.

insights.takeaway: Pension benefits are calculated based on your total pensionable service history and specific formulas, not on the accumulated balance shown in your pension column.
insights.quote: It isn't calculated on the actual amount that is accumulated in the Pension Fund, rather depends on certain Formulas.

insights.takeaway: When you transfer PF, the system updates your service history instead of moving the pension money. Verify that your date of joining and exit are correctly updated in the member portal.
insights.quote: Due to the service history update, the benefit that you receive is you get to know how much is your Total Pensionable Service during that time.

insights.takeaway: To verify if your transfer was successful, check your claim status on the EPFO portal. Once the status shows as settled, your service history should reflect the updated details.
insights.quote: Once you visit the Claim status, when you find that your claim status reflects settled. It means that your amount has been transferred.

insights.takeaway: The Atal Bimit Vyakti Kalyan Yojna under ESIC provides a 90-day unemployment allowance to eligible individuals. Check your eligibility if you are covered under ESIC.
insights.quote: Under which, ESI is providing you with 90-day Unemployment Allowance. All those individuals who are covered under this, should definitely watch the video.

insights.takeaway: Claim settlement ratios are often misleading because they do not reveal why claims were rejected. They are historical statistics, not a probability of your specific claim being approved.
insights.quote: जब तक हम यह नहीं बता सकते की क्लेम क्यों रिजेक्ट हुए हैं तब तक हम क्लेम सेटलमेंट रेशों के नंबर से कुछ भी कनक्लूड नहीं कर सकते

insights.takeaway: Distinguish between claim rejection and repudiation. Rejection is often a temporary issue due to incomplete documentation, while repudiation is a final decision after investigation, usually due to non-disclosure.
insights.quote: रिजेक्शन इस टेंपरेरी या उसे पे ज्यादा ध्यान मत दो... रिपुडिएशन में वो पूरा इन्वेस्टिगेशन प्रोसेस होता है

insights.takeaway: When choosing an insurer, prioritize companies with high Assets Under Management (AUM), strong brand reputation, and backing from large, stable financial institutions to ensure long-term reliability.
insights.quote: जितनी बड़ी कंपनी है जितना बड़ा एयूएम है उतनी स्टेबल है

insights.takeaway: Always scrutinize critical illness and accidental disability riders for hidden conditions. Some insurers deduct rider payouts from the base life cover, while others provide them as an additional benefit.
insights.quote: काफी कंपनी की ये स्टैंडर्ड प्रैक्टिस है अगर आपने 1 करोड़ की पॉलिसी ली और 30 लाख का क्रिटिकल इलनेस राइडर लिया... तो कई कंपनी वो एक करोड़ के कर में से ही 30 लक्स निकालकर आपको देती है

insights.takeaway: To ensure your claim is never rejected, disclose all medical history, habits, and pre-existing conditions accurately at the time of purchase. Honesty is the best defense against claim repudiation.
insights.quote: मेक सर पॉलिसी लेते वक्त आप साड़ी चीज एक्युरेटली डिस्क्लोजर करो

insights.takeaway: Maintain a physical and digital record of your health checkups every six months. This establishes a timeline of your health status, helping your family prove that illnesses were diagnosed after the policy start date.
insights.quote: पॉलिसी लेने के बाद से आप ये फ्रंट ले लो हर 6 मंथ्स में एक बार जाकर आपको फूल बॉडी चेकअप करवाना है

insights.takeaway: Be aware of policy exclusions such as suicide within the first 12 months, criminal activities, driving under the influence, or murder by the nominee, as these will lead to claim denial.
insights.quote: सात-आठ टाइप की डेथ्स होती हैं जिसमें क्लेम नहीं मिलता है वो आपको पता होना चाहिए

insights.takeaway: Tax planning is ineffective if done at the end of the financial year. To maximize exemptions and avoid penalties, you must optimize your salary structure and investments at the start of the year.
insights.quote: Tax planning starts with the beginning of the financial year.

insights.takeaway: Never rely on verbal promises from bank sales representatives. If offered a lifetime free credit card or special benefit, insist on receiving confirmation via an official bank email address.
insights.quote: Tell him that he mail to you in the written from the official mail ID.

insights.takeaway: Always review your bank statements monthly. If you spot suspicious or unexplained charges, contact customer care immediately to clarify the reason for the deduction.
insights.quote: Review your bank statement at least for a month.

insights.takeaway: Enable default call recording on your smartphone. Having recordings of conversations with bank representatives serves as critical evidence if you are later misled or cheated by sales staff.
insights.quote: Record all conversations with unknown numbers.

insights.takeaway: If a bank fails to resolve your complaint, escalate it to the RBI Ombudsman. You must first attempt to resolve the issue with the bank directly before approaching the Ombudsman.
insights.quote: If a bank or NBFC does not resolve your complaint properly... you can go to this website of RBI.

insights.takeaway: When filing a complaint with the RBI Ombudsman, compile all your evidence, including WhatsApp chats, emails, and call recordings, into a single PDF to ensure a swift and effective resolution.
insights.quote: In PDF format he attached all conversations, WhatsApp chat-proof.

insights.takeaway: The Employee Pension Scheme (EPS) requires a minimum of 10 years of service to qualify for a lifelong pension. Service periods of 6 months or more are rounded up to one year.
insights.quote: For pension, minimum 10 years of service is compulsory.

insights.takeaway: The maximum monthly salary considered for EPS contribution is capped at Rs 15,000. Consequently, the maximum monthly contribution to the pension fund is fixed at Rs 1,250.
insights.quote: the maximum limit of contribution towards EPS, has been kept only Rs.15,000 Basic + DA.

insights.takeaway: You do not earn interest on the money accumulated in your EPS fund. Interest is only earned on the EPF portion of your provident fund contributions.
insights.quote: there is no interest on EPS fund.

insights.takeaway: Standard pension begins at age 58, but you can opt for an early pension starting at age 50, provided you have completed 10 years of service and are currently unemployed.
insights.quote: You can start the early pension after reaching the age of 50 years.

insights.takeaway: Opting for early pension before age 58 results in a permanent reduction of your monthly pension amount by 4% for every year you retire early.
insights.quote: if you start an early pension, then every year, you face a loss of 4%.

insights.takeaway: If you leave your job with less than 10 years of service, you can either withdraw your EPS contributions using Form 10C or obtain a Scheme Certificate to carry your service history forward.
insights.quote: you can withdraw your EPS money... or you can ask a Scheme Certificate from the department.

insights.takeaway: The monthly pension amount under the EPS scheme is generally capped between Rs 1,000 and Rs 7,500, though special clauses may allow for higher amounts in specific cases.
insights.quote: the pension you will get, will be in between Rs 1,000 to Rs 7,500 per month.

insights.takeaway: ULIPs combine insurance and investment, but they are inefficient because high mortality and administrative charges are deducted from your investment before any returns are generated.
insights.quote: Your money will be invested after deduction of a lot of charges.

insights.takeaway: A life insurance cover should ideally be 10 to 25 times your annual income to ensure your family can maintain their lifestyle in your absence.
insights.quote: Your insurance cover should be minimum 10X of your annual income after tax.

insights.takeaway: Term insurance is significantly cheaper and more effective than ULIPs. You can secure a large cover for a small annual premium without mixing it with investment products.
insights.quote: If you want 1 crore term insurance cover and you are 25 years old Then your annual premium will be 10-12,000 Rupees.

insights.takeaway: Mortality charges in ULIPs increase exponentially with age, meaning a larger portion of your premium is consumed by insurance costs as you grow older, reducing your actual investment.
insights.quote: This charge is increasing exponentially This is your charge when you are young.

insights.takeaway: If you have recently purchased a ULIP, utilize the 15 to 30-day free-look period to cancel the policy and recover your entire premium without any penalty.
insights.quote: Every policy has some 15/30 days free lock-in period. You can get your entire money back without any penalty.

insights.takeaway: Do not mix insurance and investment. Buy a pure term insurance plan for protection and use mutual funds, PPF, or ELSS for wealth creation and tax saving.
insights.quote: The first priority should be life insurance as we can die anytime. You should use the rest of your money to create wealth.

insights.takeaway: If your ULIP is older than 5 years, it is often better to stop paying premiums and accept the loss rather than continuing to pay high charges that erode your capital.
insights.quote: Pay the penalty or charges but discontinue that once Then term insurance + mutual funds combo will be better for you.

insights.takeaway: Government departments like TRAI or police will never call you to threaten that your mobile services or Aadhaar card will be deactivated due to illegal activities.
insights.quote: दूरसंचार विभाग आपको सूचित करता है कि आपके मोबाइल फोन नंबर की कई बार रिपोर्ट गई है

insights.takeaway: Scammers use a multi-stage process where a 'junior' officer filters victims and transfers them to a 'senior' officer to build credibility and pressure.
insights.quote: यह जो पहला बंदा था ना यह एक तरह से समझ लो कि सबसे बेस लेवल पर काम कर रहा है

insights.takeaway: Never share your screen, install remote access apps, or save unknown numbers provided by callers claiming to be officials to 'file a complaint'.
insights.quote: वहां पर आप नंबर डालिए नंबर जो मैंने आपको बताया था

insights.takeaway: Scammers create a false sense of urgency, claiming you must act within 30 minutes to prevent your Aadhaar from being blacklisted or facing arrest.
insights.quote: आने वाले आधे घंटे में आपका आधार कार्ड पांच साल के लिए ब्लैक लिस्ट किया जा रहा है

insights.takeaway: If a caller asks you to stay on a recorded line, transfer your call to a police station, or threatens 'digital arrest', hang up immediately. It is a scam.
insights.quote: हो सकता है नेक्स्ट लेवल पे मुझे वीडियो कॉल पे कोई अदालत का भी सीन दिखा दे

insights.takeaway: Official police complaints are filed in person at a station or through the official government portal, not via WhatsApp video calls or random phone transfers.
insights.quote: पता है कि कंप्लेंट दर्ज करवाने के लिए फिजिकली अपर होकर कंप्लेंट दर्ज करवाना पड़ती है

insights.takeaway: All scheduled banks in India are covered by DICGC insurance, which protects your deposits up to Rs 5 lakh per bank in the event of a bank failure.
insights.quote: All of them have RBI's DICGC Insurance. which insures the deposit upto Rs 5L.

insights.takeaway: An IFSC code consists of 11 characters: the first four identify the bank, the fifth is always zero, and the last six represent the specific branch code.
insights.quote: Whose first 4 digit states the bank name... The 5th character of this code remains constant. Which is always '0'.

insights.takeaway: To maximize safety and insurance coverage, avoid keeping more than Rs 5 lakh in a single bank's fixed deposit, as that is the maximum limit covered by DICGC.
insights.quote: With any single bank account. Don't create a FD of more than 5L. So that you get RBI's Full Insurance.

insights.takeaway: If your annual interest income from a bank exceeds Rs 40,000, the bank will deduct 10% TDS. You can submit Form 15G or 15H to avoid this if your income is below the taxable limit.
insights.quote: If you don't come under Taxable Limit. So, in that particular case... You can fill out Form 15G or 15H and submit in the bank.

insights.takeaway: For cheques exceeding Rs 50,000, you must use the Positive Pay System (PPS) to reconfirm details with your bank, otherwise the cheque may not be cleared.
insights.quote: If you are giving someone a cheque of more than Rs 50,000, then it's important to mention that in PPS.

insights.takeaway: Cheque bouncing is a criminal offence in India. Always ensure you have sufficient funds in your account before issuing a cheque to avoid legal consequences.
insights.quote: Following which that cheque... was not honoured in the other respective branch. Then this is known as 'Cheque Bounce'. And in India, it is a criminal offence.

insights.takeaway: If you face unresolved issues or illegal practices by a bank, you can file a formal complaint through the RBI Ombudsman portal for effective resolution.
insights.quote: If the banks are troubling you. If something illegal happens... Then to complain about it... you will have to approach 'RBI Ombudsman'.

insights.takeaway: ASBA (Applications Supported by Blocked Accounts) allows you to apply for IPOs by blocking the required funds in your account rather than transferring them immediately.
insights.quote: Here the money will stay in your account, i.e. Blocked. If you get the IPO, then the amount will be deducted.

insights.takeaway: If you have a bank account linked to a service provider, ensure you understand the terms. Paytm opened bank accounts for users without explicit consent during standard KYC processes.
insights.quote: The bank account of lakhs of people was opened by tricking them.

insights.takeaway: Always check if your interest income from bank accounts is correctly reported in your Annual Information Statement (AIS) to avoid tax discrepancies caused by bank reporting errors.
insights.quote: I did not get the interest of Paytm Bank. That means Paytm gave you interest, but its information was not reported against your PAN.

insights.takeaway: If a company faces repeated regulatory bans and penalties over several years, it indicates systemic governance issues that pose a significant risk to retail investors and depositors.
insights.quote: I have not seen any such entity, which is so stubborn, that even after being banned again and again, it does not improve its shortcomings.

insights.takeaway: If you use a digital wallet or payments bank, ensure your automated EMI payments are not linked to an account facing regulatory restrictions to avoid payment defaults.
insights.quote: If you have any loan going on whose EMI is deducted from your Paytm Payments Bank, then please change it.

insights.takeaway: A company using IPO proceeds to buy back its own shares shortly after listing may indicate a lack of clear business growth plans or an attempt to artificially support stock prices.
insights.quote: So the money you raised from the public for the growth of the company, how are you doing share buyback with the same money?

insights.takeaway: When evaluating a company, look beyond the valuation. A complex 'A to G' business model that is difficult to explain often masks fundamental operational or regulatory weaknesses.
insights.quote: We acquire customers for A. A makes money while more money is made on the derivatives of A which are B, C and D.

insights.takeaway: Use the Schedule Send feature in Gmail to prepare emails in advance and have them sent automatically at a specific date and time, perfect for managing time zones or leave.
insights.quote: As soon as the time is achieved, your mail will automatically send to the other side.

insights.takeaway: Confidential Mode allows you to send emails that recipients cannot forward, copy, print, or download, with the option to set an expiration date or require a passcode.
insights.quote: Confidential Mode allows you to send such emails That you don’t want the other person can download, print, or forward it to anyone else.

insights.takeaway: Enable the Undo Send feature in Gmail settings to increase your cancellation window up to 30 seconds, providing a safety net for accidental sends or missing attachments.
insights.quote: If you want the limit to be increased from 5 seconds to 30 seconds then you go for settings.

insights.takeaway: Create a professional email signature in Gmail settings to automatically include your name, designation, company, and contact details in every outgoing message.
insights.quote: You can set the signature from Gmail settings. So that whenever you write an email the last part gets appeared.

insights.takeaway: Use Gmail Labels and color-coding to organize your inbox like folders, making it easier to categorize and quickly identify emails related to specific projects or tasks.
insights.quote: You can separately colour code them Suppose you want to give green colour to your marketing label and red colour to your finance label.

insights.takeaway: Use the BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) field when emailing multiple people to keep the email addresses of secondary recipients hidden from the primary recipient and others.
insights.quote: BCC=BLIND CARBON COPY. And I was shocked that even today's date some people have no idea about that.

insights.takeaway: Save time on repetitive emails by using Gmail's 'Templates' feature (formerly Canned Responses) to store and quickly insert pre-written email drafts.
insights.quote: You can create and save one email template. After that, you just choose the template.

insights.takeaway: Install a grammar-checking extension like Grammarly to automatically identify and correct spelling, punctuation, and grammatical errors, ensuring your professional emails are error-free.
insights.quote: Whatever English mistakes you have It identifies your mistake and also tells you how to correct it.

insights.takeaway: Use Mail Merge tools with Google Sheets to send personalized bulk emails where specific fields like names or PNR numbers are automatically filled for each recipient.
insights.quote: You can send an email to 50 people but it should be customized.

insights.takeaway: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB) are superior to physical gold because they eliminate making charges, storage safety risks, and purity concerns while earning 2.5% annual interest.
insights.quote: There is no option in the market which can give you 3 benefits based on Gold investment.

insights.takeaway: SGBs offer tax-free capital gains if held until maturity (8 years) or redeemed after 5 years through the RBI, making them highly tax-efficient.
insights.quote: The profit that you earn that time, there will be no tax imposed on that.

insights.takeaway: Buying SGBs online through a DEMAT account provides a discount of INR 50 per gram compared to offline applications at banks or post offices.
insights.quote: By applying it online, you will receive a discount of INR 50/Gram.

insights.takeaway: Holding SGBs in a DEMAT account allows you to trade them on the secondary market before the 5-year lock-in period, providing liquidity if you need to exit early.
insights.quote: This Gold Bond is also tradeable and you can sell this to anyone whenever you want.

insights.takeaway: SGBs can be used as collateral to secure loans from banks, adding a layer of financial utility beyond simple price appreciation.
insights.quote: You can mortgage your Sovereign Gold Bond Certificate and apply for loan by speaking with the Bank.

insights.takeaway: If you sell SGBs on the secondary market via a DEMAT account, capital gains are taxable based on your holding period, unlike direct redemption with the RBI.
insights.quote: If you use this in the Secondary Market, i.e. while using the DEMAT Account, you sell it then there you will have to pay for tax.

insights.takeaway: You can potentially buy SGBs at a lower price than the current RBI issue rate by purchasing existing bonds from other sellers on the secondary stock market.
insights.quote: If I find a lower rate than the SGB price, then I can find it from there. This is an extremely smart Ninja Technique.

insights.takeaway: NPS mandates that 40 percent of your corpus be locked into an annuity plan at retirement, which provides a monthly pension but restricts your access to the principal amount.
insights.quote: 40%, you need to compulsorily take the annuity

insights.takeaway: Annuity plans offer varying pension amounts based on the provider and the specific plan chosen, such as whether the principal is returned to the nominee after death.
insights.quote: If you need a Return of Purchase then your Pension will be reduced a little

insights.takeaway: ELSS funds offer higher flexibility compared to NPS, as they have a shorter 3-year lock-in period and allow for 100 percent withdrawal of funds upon retirement.
insights.quote: If someone has done their retirement plan from ELSS Then they have complete freedom there

insights.takeaway: When choosing an ELSS fund, always opt for the 'Direct' plan to avoid paying high distributor commissions, which can significantly impact your long-term returns over decades.
insights.quote: In Regular Plan Your distributor commission will be levied higher

insights.takeaway: Liquid funds are a low-risk, short-term debt instrument that can serve as an alternative to annuities, allowing you to generate monthly income while retaining access to your principal.
insights.quote: What is Liquid Mutual Fund? I will explain that to you first These are short-term debt based funds

insights.takeaway: A simple rule for asset allocation is to subtract your age from 100; the resulting number is the percentage of your portfolio that should be invested in equity.
insights.quote: My age is 25 years I will deduct 25 from the 100 Then, it is 75 i.e From my Total Investment 75% should be in equity

insights.takeaway: The power of compounding relies heavily on time, so start your investments as early as possible, even if you can only afford a small amount like Rs 500 initially.
insights.quote: The magic of Power of compounding will only work when When I will be invested for a longer time

insights.takeaway: PPF accounts are highly secure investments that are legally protected from seizure, even in the event of court cases against the account holder.
insights.quote: Even if there is a court case against you, your money in a PPF account can't be seized.

insights.takeaway: To earn interest for a specific month in your PPF account, you must deposit your funds on or before the 5th day of that month.
insights.quote: Before or on the 5th of every month, if you deposit money in the PPF account, you will get interest for that month.

insights.takeaway: Depositing your annual PPF contribution before April 5th ensures you earn interest for the entire financial year, maximizing your long-term returns.
insights.quote: Try to deposit it before April 5 of each year, so that you get interest for April and for all the 12 months.

insights.takeaway: Missing the 5th-day deadline consistently over 15 years can result in a loss of over Rs. 27,000 in interest, even with the same principal amount.
insights.quote: The difference between the 2 amounts is Rs.27,152.

insights.takeaway: When depositing via cheque or demand draft, ensure it is cleared and credited into your PPF account before the 5th, or you will lose that month's interest.
insights.quote: If it doesn't get cleared by the 5th, and gets credited afterwards, you won't get interest in that amount.

insights.takeaway: Depositing your entire annual PPF contribution in the final month of the financial year after the 5th results in zero interest earned for that entire year.
insights.quote: He'll get interest for zero months each year. He won't get any interest from April to March.

insights.takeaway: EPFO allows a non-refundable PF advance for emergencies, specifically during the COVID-19 pandemic, which can be processed and credited to your bank account within three days.
insights.quote: Within 3 days your bank account will be credited with that amount

insights.takeaway: The maximum PF withdrawal limit is the lower of either three months of basic salary plus Dearness Allowance (DA) or 75 percent of your total PF balance.
insights.quote: The amount can be 3 months basic plus DA Or 75% of your PF Balance Whichever will be less

insights.takeaway: To successfully withdraw PF funds, your UAN must be KYC compliant, meaning it must be linked with your Aadhaar, PAN, and active bank account details.
insights.quote: Ensure that KYC on PF Portal is done because many people KYC is not done

insights.takeaway: When filling out the PF withdrawal form, it is advisable to request an amount slightly lower than your calculated eligibility to reduce the risk of claim rejection.
insights.quote: Be on the safer side I will type 44,500 only so that my claim could not be rejected

insights.takeaway: You cannot withdraw from the pension contribution portion of your EPF account; only the employee and employer shares are eligible for the PF advance.
insights.quote: You can't withdraw from pension amount and now we have to take the total of employee & employer share

insights.takeaway: To apply for the pandemic-related PF advance, you must select Form 31 and choose the specific purpose of 'outbreak of pandemic covid 19' in the member portal.
insights.quote: Select outbreak of pandemic covid 19 which will appear on top only

insights.takeaway: Employment bonds cannot legally force you to stay in a job. Under Indian law, you have the fundamental right to work where you choose, and no contract can override this.
insights.quote: No agreement can coerce you to continue in any job.

insights.takeaway: An employment bond is only valid if it is reasonable and reflects actual training costs incurred by the employer. Exorbitant penalty amounts listed in bonds are rarely enforceable in court.
insights.quote: You may write any amount in the bond. But the actually reasonable amount, the actual loss that the employer is bearing, Only that much amount will be payable.

insights.takeaway: Non-compete clauses that prevent you from working in your trade or profession after leaving a company are generally considered invalid and unenforceable by Indian courts.
insights.quote: Any such non compete agreement doesn't stand valid in court usually.

insights.takeaway: Confidentiality agreements are valid but must be limited to a reasonable time period. They cannot be used to claim ownership over your professional skills or restrict your work indefinitely.
insights.quote: The confidentiality clause can stay valid for a reasonable time period only and not perenially.

insights.takeaway: Employers withholding your original legal documents like Aadhar, PAN, or Passport to force you to stay or pay money is a criminal offense punishable by imprisonment.
insights.quote: Any type of extortion or harm, if you commit after threatening someone... company's management or directors can be punished for a minimum of 2 years.

insights.takeaway: Many online 'data entry' jobs use fake bond threats to extort money. If you received no formal training, these bonds are fraudulent and have no legal standing.
insights.quote: These are all fraud cases. They are fake cases and have no validity at all.

insights.takeaway: For an employment bond to be valid, it must be signed under free consent, be on proper stamp paper, and serve to protect legitimate business interests rather than extort the employee.
insights.quote: The condition should serve to protect some interest or law of the company, and not merely to extort or threaten the employee.

insights.takeaway: If a job opportunity requires you to pay money upfront for training, software, security deposits, or background checks, it is a guaranteed scam. Never pay to get a job.
insights.quote: Whenever your hear of money submission or the work in Which you have been asked to deposit money before starting any work In these cases, it is a red alert

insights.takeaway: Analyze the business model of any work-from-home offer. If you cannot understand how the company makes money, or if the pay is too high for simple tasks like typing, it is likely a scam.
insights.quote: If I am not able to understand that how a business is earning then I must stay away from it

insights.takeaway: Scammers often use fake legal threats, such as emails from 'lawyers' claiming you will be jailed for contract breach, to extort money. Ignore these; no real legal notice will be sent via email or cheap SMS.
insights.quote: They are going cross all the limits to fear you, so that you can believe That they are going to file a real court case

insights.takeaway: Verify the authenticity of a company by checking the email domain. A professional company will use its own domain (e.g., name@company.com), not a generic one like @gmail.com or a misspelled version of the brand.
insights.quote: If I am an employee of such a big company then at Last it should be "zerodha.com" and not "gmail.com"

insights.takeaway: If you have been scammed, stop working immediately and do not pay any 'penalties' or 'fees' to recover your money. Report the incident to the cybercrime cell and your bank's dispute resolution department.
insights.quote: If you are doing work for them then stop that immediately... they will never pay you any money

insights.takeaway: Legitimate part-time income requires actual skills like Excel, digital marketing, or content writing. Avoid 'data entry' jobs that require no skills and promise high payouts, as these are designed to steal your data or money.
insights.quote: For a work that does not need a skill, a computer I think that work even don't exist

insights.takeaway: Check 'consumercomplaints.in' to see if a company name appears in fraud reports. Scammers frequently change company names to avoid being flagged on such public forums.
insights.quote: If the name of any reputed company comes here then it is not a reputed company but a fake company

insights.takeaway: Under the new tax regime, individuals with an annual income up to 7 lakhs are exempt from paying income tax due to the 87A rebate.
insights.quote: With income upto 7 lakhs will not have to pay any tax at all.

insights.takeaway: The government has designated the PAN card as a common business identifier to simplify registrations across various government portals and departments.
insights.quote: So from now, PAN card will be considered as a common identifier

insights.takeaway: Small businesses and professionals can now benefit from higher turnover limits for presumptive taxation, provided 95% of their receipts are received via online payments.
insights.quote: 50 lakhs been increased to 75 lakhs and 2 crore has been raised to 3 crore

insights.takeaway: To ensure timely payments to MSMEs, big corporations cannot claim tax deductions for expenses if they fail to pay their small business vendors on time.
insights.quote: if you haven't done a timely payment to MSME invoice, then you will not be able to consider it for tax deduction

insights.takeaway: The tax-free limit for leave encashment for non-government salaried employees has been significantly increased from 3 lakhs to 25 lakhs.
insights.quote: Leave encashment limit, on which there was no tax for non-government employees. It was 3 lakh, which has been increased to 25 lakhs

insights.takeaway: TDS on PF withdrawals for members without a PAN has been reduced from 30% to 20% for amounts exceeding 50,000 rupees.
insights.quote: if you go to take out funds from your PF which was more than 50,000 rupees. Then 30% TDS was cut Now only 20% will be cut.

insights.takeaway: Choose your tax regime carefully. The new regime is beneficial if you have no investments or exemptions, but the old regime is often better for those utilizing HRA, LTA, and 80C deductions.
insights.quote: if you are a salaried employee who is getting all these allowances like HRA, LTA or Children Education Allowance... definitely you will occur loss in new tax regime.

insights.takeaway: National holidays on January 26, August 15, and October 2 are mandatory. If an industry requires work on these days, employees must be provided with a compensatory off.
insights.quote: National Holidays, as you know there are 3 holidays on which you get leave compulsorily.

insights.takeaway: Labour laws mandate at least one day of rest for every six days of work. Factories may implement this on a rotational basis to ensure continuous operations.
insights.quote: Our law mandates 1-day rest after 6 days of work to a worker.

insights.takeaway: Earned Leave (EL) or Privilege Leave (PL) accumulates if unused. Once it exceeds a state-defined cap, employees can encash the excess days as salary.
insights.quote: EL can be cashed out too. It means that if you have accumulated EL more than a limit, then you can cash it out.

insights.takeaway: Eligibility for Earned Leave usually requires working at least 240 days in a calendar year. If joining mid-year, you must work at least two-thirds of the remaining days.
insights.quote: An employee should work for a minimum of 240 days in a year.

insights.takeaway: Casual Leave (CL) is intended for unplanned needs. It cannot be carried forward to the next year or encashed, so it is often used by employees before the year ends.
insights.quote: CL can neither be cashed out nor carried forward.

insights.takeaway: For Sick Leave (SL), employers typically allow 2-3 days without documentation, but they are legally entitled to request a medical certificate for any consecutive absence longer than three days.
insights.quote: If you want more than 3 days of consecutive leave, then your employer can ask for a medical certificate.

insights.takeaway: Maternity leave is mandated at 26 weeks for eligible women. Eligibility typically requires at least 80 days of attendance within the preceding six months of employment.
insights.quote: After the recent amendment, this leave is now 26 weeks long.

insights.takeaway: Salaried individuals can file their own ITR in 10-15 minutes using the official Income Tax portal, eliminating the need to pay a professional for simple filings.
insights.quote: You can go to the income tax portal by yourself and fill your ITR in just 10-15 minutes.

insights.takeaway: Use ITR-1 only if you have salary income, one house property, and other income sources. You cannot use ITR-1 if you are a company director or hold unlisted equity shares.
insights.quote: If a person is a director in the company, or if he has unlisted equity shares... they won't be able to fill ITR 1.

insights.takeaway: Form 16 is a guide, not an absolute truth. Always verify the figures against your own records and the Annual Information Statement (AIS) before finalizing your ITR.
insights.quote: You don't have to blindly believe it. When you fill your return, then use it as a guiding and the actual number can be modified.

insights.takeaway: The new tax regime is the default option on the ITR portal. If you wish to claim deductions under the old regime, you must manually opt out of the new regime.
insights.quote: Do you want to opt out of New Tax Regime? You will see that by default, there is already selected No.

insights.takeaway: Always verify your bank details on the ITR portal, especially if your IFSC code has changed, to ensure your tax refund is credited to the correct account.
insights.quote: Do verify the bank details given below especially in the case, when the IFSC codes of the bank have changed.

insights.takeaway: If your total tax liability exceeds Rs 10,000 after TDS, you must pay advance tax by March 31st to avoid interest penalties on your tax filing.
insights.quote: If your tax liability is more than Rs 10,000, then by 31st March, you have to deposit your entire payment as an advance tax.

insights.takeaway: Declare all additional income and investment deductions to your employer during the year to prevent excess TDS deduction and avoid the opportunity cost of waiting for a refund.
insights.quote: If additional TDS is deducted, then we will definitely get a refund later, but that is definitely an opportunity cost.

insights.takeaway: Employees who retired before September 1, 2014, and contributed to their EPF on their full actual salary (rather than the statutory wage ceiling) are eligible for higher pension benefits.
insights.quote: those people, who have paid on higher EPF, towards Provident Fund, and not a Pension Fund.

insights.takeaway: To claim higher pension, you must submit a Joint Declaration Form signed by your employer, along with Form 3A (annual return) and salary slips for the last 12 months.
insights.quote: Joint Declaration Form and Form 3A, dully attested by the authorized signatory, and salary receipt of last 12 months.

insights.takeaway: Eligibility for higher pension requires that both the employee and employer previously opted to contribute to the EPF on the full actual salary, including administrative charges on the total amount.
insights.quote: In this, you have to take a joint option, both employee and employer, Take both option that we want to contribute on full.

insights.takeaway: The Supreme Court ruled that the EPFO cannot impose arbitrary cut-off dates for welfare schemes, which paved the way for pensioners to claim higher pension based on actual salary contributions.
insights.quote: Supreme Court said, you can not keep the cut off date under Welfare Scheme. You are not empowered to put any cut-off dates.

insights.takeaway: Employees who joined or were active after September 1, 2014, face stricter limitations, as the EPFO introduced a notification requiring a fresh option within a specific timeframe to contribute on full salary.
insights.quote: if any person, who was given with the option, and was getting his pension deducted on higher, they had to give a fresh option within 6 months.

insights.takeaway: Pensioners should verify if their pension was incorrectly commuted for 100 months without restoration, as the EPFO often fails to restore the full pension amount after the commutation period ends.
insights.quote: When 100 months has been completed for an individual, then it should get restore for him. This happens in Government. But, here in EPFO, they don't do this.

insights.takeaway: Fixed deposits are essentially loans you provide to a bank. The longer the tenure you commit to, the higher the interest rate the bank typically offers.
insights.quote: HD ek tarah ka loan hai jo aapne bank ko diya hai.

insights.takeaway: Even a small 0.5% to 1% difference in interest rates significantly impacts your total returns over a 5-year period due to the power of compounding.
insights.quote: Ek aadha percent ka bhi overall return mein bahut difference hota hai.

insights.takeaway: Choose cumulative FDs to earn interest on your interest. The compounding frequency matters; quarterly compounding, standard in Indian banks, yields higher returns than annual compounding.
insights.quote: Jitni zyada ye frequency hogi utna hi zyada aapka interest banega.

insights.takeaway: Breaking an FD prematurely leads to a penalty. Crucially, the bank recalculates your interest based on the actual duration the money stayed, not the original tenure, plus a penalty.
insights.quote: Jo bhi aapki interest rate hai us par 0.5 se lekar 2% ki penalty lag sakti hai.

insights.takeaway: FD interest is taxable under 'Income from Other Sources' based on your tax slab. If interest exceeds ₹10,000 in a financial year, the bank will deduct 10% TDS.
insights.quote: FD par jo bhi return banta hai wo aapki income from other sources ki tarah add hota hai.

insights.takeaway: The DICGC provides insurance up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank, covering both principal and interest. NBFCs do not offer this RBI-backed insurance guarantee.
insights.quote: Ye insurance kisi bhi bank mein chahe phir wo schedule commercial bank ho ya phir ho cooperative bank aapka 5 lakh tak ka principal as well as interest protected rakhna hai.

insights.takeaway: Use the Rule of 72 to estimate how long it takes to double your money: divide 72 by the annual interest rate offered by the bank.
insights.quote: Rule of 72 ye magic formula hai jise aap pata kar sakte ho ki aapne jitne bhi principal amount ki FD karwayi hai wo kitne saalon mein double hogi.

insights.takeaway: Flexi-deposits automatically move excess savings account funds into an FD, earning better interest while maintaining liquidity, as the FD breaks automatically if your balance drops.
insights.quote: Flexi deposit feature on karne se aap apne savings account mein hi pade hue paise par better return prapt kar sakte hain.

insights.takeaway: MSME registration, formerly known as Udyog Aadhar, is now free and provides small businesses access to collateral-free loans, interest rate discounts, and government tender opportunities.
insights.quote: Yes, it was paid earlier but now this registration is free.

insights.takeaway: MSME-registered businesses are legally protected against delayed payments. If a customer fails to pay within 45 days, they must pay compound interest at three times the bank rate.
insights.quote: If he delays from 45 days then he will have to pay you compound interest along with principle.

insights.takeaway: The government offers a Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme to help businesses upgrade old machinery by providing capital subsidies for purchasing new technology.
insights.quote: You are encouraged to buy the technology you will be offered capital subsidy meaning you can buy the technology at cheaper rate.

insights.takeaway: To qualify for MSME registration, manufacturing businesses must have an investment in plant and machinery under 10 crore, while service sector businesses must have an investment under 5 crore.
insights.quote: If your business is in manufacturing sector then the investment should be less than 10 crore in plant and machinery.

insights.takeaway: You can register multiple businesses under the same owner using the Udyog Aadhar portal, as each registration is linked to the specific business activity rather than just the individual.
insights.quote: One person can have more than one business. So you can come here, for all your businesses and generate it's Udyog Aadhar.

insights.takeaway: When filling out the MSME registration form, investment figures should be entered in lakhs. For example, enter '1' if your investment is 1 lakh, rather than writing out all the zeros.
insights.quote: For 1 lakh don't put 5 zeros after 1 rather write 1 because here investments in lakhs are being considered.

insights.takeaway: Service outsourcing is more scalable than freelancing. While freelancing is a one-off task, outsourcing involves handling recurring business processes like payroll or tax filing for long-term clients.
insights.quote: फ्रीलांसिंग का एक इवॉल्वड वर्जन है सर्विस आउटसोर्सिंग

insights.takeaway: Identify your niche by listing your skills, education, and hobbies. Then, research how those skills can solve recurring problems for businesses, such as accounting, marketing, or compliance.
insights.quote: आपकी जो भी स्किल्स है जो भी इंटरेस्ट हैं जो भी एक्सपीरियंस हैं जो भी एक्सपर्टीज है उन सभी को आप किसी ना किसी फॉर्म में मोनेटाइज कर सकते हैं

insights.takeaway: Do not rush to register a private limited company or LLP initially. Start as a sole proprietorship to keep compliance costs low until you have a stable client base.
insights.quote: पहला क्लाइंट अपने नाम से लीजिए, पहला पेमेंट अपने बैंक अकाउंट में लीजिए

insights.takeaway: You do not need a GST registration until your annual turnover exceeds 20 lakhs. Avoid unnecessary compliance burdens and tax costs in the early stages of your business.
insights.quote: 20 लाख तक जब तक आपका ओवर नहीं हो जाता तब तक जीएसटी नंबर मैंडेटरी नहीं है

insights.takeaway: Use Google My Business to gain local visibility. Listing your services helps potential clients find you when they search for specific professional help in their area.
insights.quote: अपनी google my business पर प्रोफाइल बनाइए

insights.takeaway: Scale your business by building a team and standardizing processes. Creating common templates for client data helps reduce your manual workload and improves efficiency.
insights.quote: स्केलिंग का फर्स्ट पार्ट हुआ इन्वेस्ट इन टीम एंड प्रोसेसेस

insights.takeaway: Networking with other consultants in your industry allows you to offer comprehensive solutions. If you lack a specific skill, partner with someone in your network to retain clients.
insights.quote: अपने तरह के कंसल्टेंट्स के साथ अपनी इंडस्ट्री में नेटवर्क करिए

insights.takeaway: Always open a separate current account for your business rather than using a personal savings account. This keeps business transactions distinct and helps avoid scrutiny from the income tax department.
insights.quote: If you want to do business then open a Current A/c and through it do the transactions.

insights.takeaway: A proprietor and their business are legally the same entity. This means you do not have a separate PAN for your firm, and all business income is reported under your personal ITR.
insights.quote: Proprietor and his firm don't have Separate PAN cards, Means whenever I'll file ITR all my businesses will be reported in one ITR only.

insights.takeaway: Do not register for GST until you cross the mandatory turnover threshold (40 Lakhs for goods, 20 Lakhs for services) unless necessary for specific contracts or online selling, to keep your pricing competitive.
insights.quote: Otherwise, you should not take the GST certificate if your threshold is not crossed.

insights.takeaway: Under the presumptive taxation scheme (Section 44AD), small businesses with turnover under 2 crores can pay tax on a fixed percentage of income (6-8%) without needing to maintain detailed books or undergo audits.
insights.quote: When your business's annual Turnover is less than 2 crores then your file your return in 44AD.

insights.takeaway: Business expenses like fuel or travel can be claimed as deductions to lower your taxable income, a benefit that salaried employees typically do not receive.
insights.quote: A salaried person doesn't get that many deductions which a businessman gets.

insights.takeaway: If you hire 10 or more employees, consider forming a partnership firm instead of a proprietorship. This provides better legal structure, separate PAN, and simplifies compliance for PF, ESI, and business closure.
insights.quote: After 10 generally, you should work by forming a partnership firm.

insights.takeaway: Cash transactions above 10,000 rupees generally cannot be claimed as business deductions. However, this limit does not apply to those filing under the presumptive taxation scheme.
insights.quote: In most cases maximum limit for cash trans. is Rs 10K. Above it, if you do any transaction in cash then you will not be able to claim it.

insights.takeaway: Proprietorships carry high personal risk because your personal assets can be attached to settle business debts. For scaling or seeking external funding, consider a Private Limited company or OPC.
insights.quote: If you default loan then your Banks and other financial institutions can recover it from your personal assets.

insights.takeaway: Income tax is progressive, but the government adds surcharges for high earners and a 4% health and education cess on top of the calculated tax liability.
insights.quote: I will mention additional 4% CESS. Citizens won't understand that.

insights.takeaway: Advance tax requires individuals to pay their estimated tax liability in quarterly installments throughout the year, rather than waiting until the end of the financial year.
insights.quote: Just keep paying me taxes quarterly throughout the year.

insights.takeaway: The new tax regime simplifies filing by removing most exemptions and deductions, whereas the old regime allows you to reduce taxable income using HRA, LTA, and 80C/80D deductions.
insights.quote: The major difference in the old and new regime is, there are no exemptions or deductions available in the new regime.

insights.takeaway: Capital gains tax applies to profits from investments like stocks and mutual funds, with different rates for short-term and long-term holdings.
insights.quote: If the profit has formed in the short term, then you'll have to pay 20% tax.

insights.takeaway: Securities Transaction Tax (STT) is a mandatory levy on all stock market transactions, including intraday and F&O, regardless of whether the trade results in a profit or a loss.
insights.quote: Whether you earn profit or incur loss, the government earns from it.

insights.takeaway: Property ownership involves multiple layers of taxation, including municipal property taxes, registration charges, and stamp duty, which can significantly increase the total cost of acquisition.
insights.quote: If you purchase a house worth ₹50 lakhs, then you will have to pay Stamp duty of ₹4 to ₹5 lakhs.

insights.takeaway: The effective GST on many goods is higher than the base slab due to 'Compensation CESS', which is applied to items like cars and luxury goods, sometimes pushing total taxes above 50%.
insights.quote: That means, the effective GST levied is not 28%.. but it could have increased upto 30%, 40%, 50%, 60% or 100%.

insights.takeaway: Petrol and alcohol remain outside the GST framework, meaning they are subject to high state-level VAT and central excise duties, which vary significantly by region.
insights.quote: Petrol and Alcohol. And still our #10 Indirect Tax, i.e. VAT and Excise Duty.

insights.takeaway: True wealth is defined by having enough to cover your annual expenses multiplied by 30 to 33, ensuring you can sustain your lifestyle for the rest of your life.
insights.quote: Annual expenses. If you multiply it by 30 And you have that much money in your Bank Account.

insights.takeaway: Avoid impulsive financial decisions by understanding the difference between temporary market dips and poor fund performance, rather than reacting to short-term percentage changes.
insights.quote: We are not able to distinguish whether this 2% is because of That because it's temporarily down.

insights.takeaway: Compounding works best when you are not looking; constant monitoring and frequent rebalancing often lead to premature selling and interrupted growth.
insights.quote: Compounding is the thing that happens when you are not looking.

insights.takeaway: Instead of selling investments and paying capital gains tax for short-term liquidity needs, consider taking a short-term loan against your assets if the interest cost is lower than the tax.
insights.quote: Is it cheaper to pay the Government Rs 5,000 Or to pay Rs 1,000 to the bank.

insights.takeaway: No-cost EMIs are often deceptive; they frequently involve hidden costs like lost cashback, processing fees, and 18% GST on the interest component, effectively raising the real interest rate.
insights.quote: It is like taking a loan on the Interest Card. That interest itself has GST, 18%.

insights.takeaway: Financial systems are designed to keep you in debt; recognize that credit is a tool that requires extreme discipline and should not be used for lifestyle consumption.
insights.quote: I think, credit is a disease. At some level. And credit is very good at other level.

insights.takeaway: An Interim Budget is presented by an outgoing government before elections. It focuses on essential spending, while the full, detailed budget is announced by the new government later in the year.
insights.quote: The new government that will come... They will announce the full budget in July.

insights.takeaway: The government has announced a subsidy scheme for rooftop solar installations, targeting 1 crore households to promote renewable energy adoption at the residential level.
insights.quote: The target is to install rooftop solar in 1 cr households.

insights.takeaway: Increased government capital expenditure on infrastructure, such as roads and railways, is historically correlated with long-term economic growth and often provides a positive outlook for the stock market.
insights.quote: Capex Investment and Long term economic growth... There is a strong co-relation.

insights.takeaway: A lower fiscal deficit is a positive macroeconomic indicator, as it helps keep inflation under control and improves the overall financial health of the country.
insights.quote: The lower this fiscal deficit is... It is better macro-economically.

insights.takeaway: The government has introduced an amnesty program to withdraw or forgive long-pending, small-value income tax demands from previous years, specifically for demands up to Rs 25,000 or Rs 10,000.
insights.quote: Close to 1 Cr people... all of them will be withdrawn/ forgiven.

insights.takeaway: Purchasing term and health insurance before the end of the financial year allows you to claim tax deductions under Section 80C and 80D in your ITR.
insights.quote: If you pay your Premium before March. Then for that premium... you can claim this in your ITR.

insights.takeaway: Buying term insurance at a younger age locks in a lower premium rate for the entire duration of the policy, saving you significant costs over your lifetime.
insights.quote: As soon or as young, you purchase a Term Insurance for yourself. The lower the premium is fixed.

insights.takeaway: Section 80C allows you to reduce your taxable income by up to ₹1.5 Lakhs. You can claim this deduction through mandatory expenses like EPF contributions and home loan principal payments without making new investments.
insights.quote: This reduces your taxable income directly by 1.5 Lakhs

insights.takeaway: EPF contributions fall under the EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) category, meaning your contributions, the interest earned, and the final withdrawal amount are all tax-free.
insights.quote: Investment of EPF comes under the EEE Category. i.e Exempt, Exempt, Exempt

insights.takeaway: You can claim a deduction under Section 80C for the tuition fees paid for up to two children. This applies to fees paid to schools or colleges in India, but not to private coaching centers.
insights.quote: Based on the components, the part of the Tuition Fee that you are paying, you can claim a deduction only on that.

insights.takeaway: Life insurance premiums are deductible under Section 80C, provided the annual premium does not exceed 10% of the total sum insured. Term insurance is generally recommended over endowment or ULIP plans.
insights.quote: The premium that is paid on Life Insurance Policy within a year, even that can be claimed under Section 80 C.

insights.takeaway: NPS is a high-priority investment because it is EEE-compliant and offers an additional ₹50,000 tax deduction under Section 80CCD(1B), over and above the ₹1.5 Lakh limit of Section 80C.
insights.quote: not only in Section 80C but also you can claim an additional deduction of INR 50,000/- under Section 80CCD Sub Section (IB).

insights.takeaway: ELSS mutual funds are ideal for tax saving if you prefer a shorter lock-in period of 3 years. While they are EET-compliant (taxable on withdrawal), they offer higher potential returns compared to traditional instruments.
insights.quote: If you don't wish to block your money. and still take advantage of 80 C Then ELSS is a great option for you.

insights.takeaway: PPF is a highly secure, EEE-compliant investment with a 15-year lock-in period. It is legally protected from attachment by courts, making it one of the safest long-term tax-saving options.
insights.quote: And it is considered to be the most secure investment.

insights.takeaway: Avoid 5-year tax-saving FDs or Post Office schemes if possible. Their returns are often low and taxable, which may result in real returns that barely beat inflation after accounting for taxes.
insights.quote: If you are earning 7-8% returns and tax is imposed on that too, then you are earning 5-6% returns.

insights.takeaway: TDS is not your final tax liability. It is an advance tax deduction. If your total income is below the taxable limit, you can claim a refund by filing an ITR.
insights.quote: TDS kabhi bhi actual income tax nahi hota.

insights.takeaway: Banks deduct 10% TDS on FD interest if it exceeds ₹40,000 annually (₹50,000 for senior citizens). If you fail to submit your PAN, the bank will deduct TDS at 20%.
insights.quote: Agar aapne apna PAN card submit nahi kiya hai, toh dono hi cases mein 20% TDS katega.

insights.takeaway: If your total annual income is below the taxable threshold, submit Form 15G (for individuals) or 15H (for senior citizens) to your bank to prevent TDS deduction on FD interest.
insights.quote: Form 15G or 15H tab bhara jata hai jab aap non-taxable income ke bracket mein aate hain.

insights.takeaway: To avoid TDS without submitting forms, distribute your FD investments across multiple banks or branches so that the interest income in each account stays below the ₹40,000 threshold.
insights.quote: Kisi bhi single FD mein interest 40,000 se cross na ho.

insights.takeaway: Always collect Form 16A from your bank after TDS deduction. Verify that the TDS amount mentioned in Form 16A matches the figures reflected in your Form 26AS.
insights.quote: Bank aapko Form 16A provide karega jiske andar aapka amount of deduction reflect hota hai.

insights.takeaway: FD interest is taxed on an accrual basis, meaning you must pay tax on the interest earned each year, even if the payout is only at maturity.
insights.quote: FD ka interest accrual basis par calculate kiya jaye.

insights.takeaway: Financial awareness involves two stages: realizing how money works to achieve freedom and avoiding the trap of irrational optimism where you assume your future income will always cover current reckless spending.
insights.quote: It's your decisions, that will make you wealthy in future.

insights.takeaway: An MBA in Finance focuses on corporate finance, not personal finance. Do not assume professional qualifications equate to the ability to manage your own money effectively.
insights.quote: An MBA finance will definitely not teach anyone about How to manage their own money?

insights.takeaway: Avoid investing based on 'tips' or rumors. True stock market investing requires fundamental confidence in a company's long-term growth and its ability to solve real-world problems.
insights.quote: If you enter the market through the right approach which is don't think of it like stock think of it as a commitment or confidence in a certain company.

insights.takeaway: Real estate purchased purely for investment, especially when heavily leveraged with loans, often yields poor returns after accounting for interest, taxes, and maintenance costs.
insights.quote: I ended up making about Rs. 40,000 profit which is the worst kind of investment on a 3 lakh original investment over 5 years.

insights.takeaway: Breaking your investments to cover expenses destroys the power of compounding. If you must withdraw, realize that it will take significant time and effort to recover your original growth trajectory.
insights.quote: When you break compounding Then it took the same number of years to bring it back.

insights.takeaway: The 'urban poor' trap occurs when you maintain a high-status lifestyle through debt, using EMIs for phones, cars, and clothes, while having more liabilities than actual assets.
insights.quote: Everything is okay on the face you are living in a very nice house but it is on the loan.

insights.takeaway: Small-ticket EMIs for consumer goods are often the most expensive form of debt. The low absolute monthly payment hides high interest rates that erode your long-term wealth.
insights.quote: They don't realize that they are paying 10% for the 3 months which means, it is the most expensive loan that I have ever taken.

insights.takeaway: The government has launched a unified national portal for rooftop solar subsidies, ensuring direct benefit transfer (DBT) of funds directly into the consumer's bank account after installation and inspection.
insights.quote: अब ये नए नेशनल पोर्टल के द्वारा न्यू एंड सिंपलीफाइड स्कीम में सब्सिडी डायरेक्टली कंज्यूमर के खाते में आएगी
